label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv
docstring: The `A`-points of the base change `K ⊗[k] SymmetricAlgebra k M` of the vector group on `M` are the additive monoid of `k`-linear maps `M →ₗ[k] A`. The source is the convolution monoid of `K`-algebra maps out of the base-changed bialgebra; the target is written multiplicatively as `Multiplicative (M →ₗ[k] A)` to match `≃*`.
code:
noncomputable def baseChangePointsMulEquiv :
    WithConv (K ⊗[k] SymmetricAlgebra k M →ₐ[K] A) ≃* Multiplicative (M →ₗ[k] A) :=

label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul_ι
docstring: The inverse base-changed vector-group points equivalence evaluates scalar multiples of base-changed generators by scalar multiplication of the corresponding linear-map value.
code:
theorem baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul_ι
    (φ : Multiplicative (M →ₗ[k] A)) (s : K) (m : M) :
    ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (M := M)).symm φ).ofConv
        (s ⊗ₜ[k] ι k M m) =
      s • (Multiplicative.toAdd φ m) := by

label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_ι
docstring: The inverse base-changed vector-group points equivalence takes the generator indexed by `m` to the value of the chosen linear map at `m`.
code:
theorem baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_ι
    (φ : Multiplicative (M →ₗ[k] A)) (m : M) :
    ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (M := M)).symm φ).ofConv
        (1 ⊗ₜ[k] ι k M m) =
      Multiplicative.toAdd φ m := by

label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaBaseChangePointsMulEquiv
docstring: The base-changed one-dimensional additive group `𝔾ₐ` has `A`-points the additive monoid of the value algebra `A`.
code:
noncomputable def gaBaseChangePointsMulEquiv :
    WithConv (K ⊗[k] SymmetricAlgebra k k →ₐ[K] A) ≃* Multiplicative A :=

label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaBaseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_ι
docstring: The inverse base-changed `𝔾ₐ` points equivalence takes the generator `1 ⊗ ι(1)` to the chosen value.
code:
theorem gaBaseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_ι (a : Multiplicative A) :
    ((gaBaseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A)).symm a).ofConv
        (1 ⊗ₜ[k] ι k k 1) =
      Multiplicative.toAdd a := by

label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaPointsMulEquiv
docstring: **The one-dimensional additive monoid of points** for `𝔾ₐ = Spec (SymmetricAlgebra R R)`. Specializing the vector group to `M = R`, the convolution monoid of `A`-valued points over `R` is the additive monoid `(A, +)`.
code:
noncomputable def gaPointsMulEquiv :
    WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A) ≃* Multiplicative A :=

label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaPointsMulEquiv_inv
docstring: Over commutative rings, `gaPointsMulEquiv` identifies the convolution inverse of a `𝔾ₐ`-point with negation in the value ring.
code:
theorem gaPointsMulEquiv_inv (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A)) :
    gaPointsMulEquiv (F⁻¹) = (gaPointsMulEquiv F)⁻¹ :=

label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaPointsMulEquiv_mapValue
docstring: The `𝔾ₐ` points equivalence is natural in the value algebra.
code:
theorem gaPointsMulEquiv_mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A)) :
    gaPointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := B)
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R R) φ F) =
      Multiplicative.ofAdd (φ (Multiplicative.toAdd (gaPointsMulEquiv F))) := by

label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_ι
docstring: The inverse equivalence sends an element of the value algebra to the corresponding `A`-valued point of `𝔾ₐ`.
code:
theorem gaPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_ι (a : Multiplicative A) :
    ((gaPointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A)).symm a).ofConv (ι R R 1) =
      Multiplicative.toAdd a := by

label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.mapValue_gaPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
docstring: Naturality of the inverse `𝔾ₐ` points equivalence in the value algebra.
code:
theorem mapValue_gaPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (φ : A →ₐ[R] B) (a : Multiplicative A) :
    AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R R) φ
        ((gaPointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A)).symm a) =
      (gaPointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := B)).symm
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd (φ (Multiplicative.toAdd a))) := by

label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
docstring: Naturality of the inverse vector-group points equivalence in the value algebra.
code:
theorem mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (ψ : Multiplicative (M →ₗ[R] A)) :
    AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R M) φ
        ((pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (M := M) (A := A)).symm ψ) =
      (pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (M := M) (A := B)).symm
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd (φ.toLinearMap.comp (Multiplicative.toAdd ψ))) := by

label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.pointsMulEquiv
docstring: **The convolution monoid of points of a vector group.** For a commutative `R`-algebra `A`, the convolution monoid of `R`-algebra maps out of `SymmetricAlgebra R M` is the additive monoid of `R`-linear maps `M →ₗ[R] A`: a point `F` corresponds to the linear map `x ↦ F (ι x)`, and convolution of points corresponds to addition of linear maps.
code:
@[expose] noncomputable def pointsMulEquiv :
    WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A) ≃* Multiplicative (M →ₗ[R] A) where

label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.pointsMulEquiv_inv
docstring: Over commutative rings, `pointsMulEquiv` identifies the convolution inverse of a point with negation of the corresponding linear map.
code:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_inv (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A)) :
    pointsMulEquiv (F⁻¹) = (pointsMulEquiv F)⁻¹ :=

label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.pointsMulEquiv_mapValue
docstring: The vector-group points equivalence is natural in the value algebra.
code:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A)) :
    pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (M := M) (A := B)
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R M) φ F) =
      Multiplicative.ofAdd
        (φ.toLinearMap.comp (Multiplicative.toAdd (pointsMulEquiv F))) := by

label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
docstring: The inverse equivalence sends a linear map to the corresponding algebra map.
code:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (φ : Multiplicative (M →ₗ[R] A)) :
    (pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (M := M) (A := A)).symm φ =
      toConv (SymmetricAlgebra.lift (Multiplicative.toAdd φ)) :=

label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply
docstring: The base-changed vector-group points equivalence reads a point by evaluating it on the base-changed generator `1 ⊗ ι(m)`.
code:
theorem toAdd_baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply
    (F : WithConv (K ⊗[k] SymmetricAlgebra k M →ₐ[K] A)) (m : M) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (baseChangePointsMulEquiv F) m =
      F.ofConv (1 ⊗ₜ[k] ι k M m) := by

label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_gaBaseChangePointsMulEquiv
docstring: The base-changed `𝔾ₐ` points equivalence reads a point by evaluating it on `1 ⊗ ι(1)`.
code:
theorem toAdd_gaBaseChangePointsMulEquiv
    (F : WithConv (K ⊗[k] SymmetricAlgebra k k →ₐ[K] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (gaBaseChangePointsMulEquiv F) =
      F.ofConv (1 ⊗ₜ[k] ι k k 1) := by

label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv
docstring: A point of `𝔾ₐ` is the additive group element obtained by evaluating it at the generator `ι 1`.
code:
theorem toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (gaPointsMulEquiv F) = F.ofConv (ι R R 1) := by

label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv_inv
docstring: In additive notation, the convolution inverse of a `𝔾ₐ`-point is the negative of its value on the generator `ι 1`.
code:
theorem toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv_inv (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (gaPointsMulEquiv (F⁻¹)) = -Multiplicative.toAdd (gaPointsMulEquiv F) := by

label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv_mapValue
docstring: Reading a `𝔾ₐ`-point as an element of the value algebra is natural in the value algebra: post-composing the point with an `R`-algebra map applies that map to the corresponding element.
code:
theorem toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv_mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd
        (gaPointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := B)
          (AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R R) φ F)) =
      φ (Multiplicative.toAdd (gaPointsMulEquiv F)) := by

label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_pointsMulEquiv
docstring: A point of the additive group, as a linear map, is `x ↦ F (ι x)`.
code:
theorem toAdd_pointsMulEquiv (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (pointsMulEquiv F) = SymmetricAlgebra.lift.symm F.ofConv :=

label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_pointsMulEquiv_apply
docstring: The linear map underlying a point evaluates as `x ↦ F (ι x)`.
code:
theorem toAdd_pointsMulEquiv_apply (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A)) (x : M) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (pointsMulEquiv F) x = F.ofConv (ι R M x) :=

label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_pointsMulEquiv_inv
docstring: In additive notation, the convolution inverse of a point corresponds to negating its linear map of generator values.
code:
theorem toAdd_pointsMulEquiv_inv (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (pointsMulEquiv (F⁻¹)) = -Multiplicative.toAdd (pointsMulEquiv F) := by

label: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_pointsMulEquiv_mapValue
docstring: Reading a vector-group point as a linear map is natural in the value algebra: post-composing the point with an `R`-algebra map post-composes the corresponding linear map.
code:
theorem toAdd_pointsMulEquiv_mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd
        (pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (M := M) (A := B)
          (AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R M) φ F)) =
      φ.toLinearMap.comp (Multiplicative.toAdd (pointsMulEquiv F)) := by

label: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
docstring: The inverse product-points map is natural in the value algebra. Assembling an `A`-valued product point from a pair of factor points and then post-composing by `φ : A →ₐ[R] B` is the same as post-composing both factor points by `φ` and then assembling the resulting `B`-valued product point.
code:
theorem mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (p : WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A) × WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) :
    AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) φ
        ((pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂) (A := A)).symm p) =
      (pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂) (A := B)).symm
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₁) φ p.1, AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₂) φ p.2) := by

label: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul
docstring: On pure tensors, naturality of the inverse product-points map says that post-composition by `φ` evaluates as applying `φ` to the product of the two factor values.
code:
theorem mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (p : WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A) × WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) (x : H₁) (y : H₂) :
    (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) φ
        ((pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂) (A := A)).symm p)).ofConv
        (x ⊗ₜ[R] y) =
      φ (p.1.ofConv x * p.2.ofConv y) := by

label: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.pointsMulEquiv
docstring: The convolution monoid of `R`-algebra homomorphisms out of a tensor product of commutative bialgebras `H₁ ⊗[R] H₂` is the product of the convolution monoids out of `H₁` and `H₂`. On the functor of points this is the direct product of the affine group schemes `Spec H₁` and `Spec H₂`: Mathlib's product map sends `x ⊗ₜ y` to `f₁ x * f₂ y`, and convolution is computed componentwise. When `H₁` and `H₂` are Hopf algebras these convolution monoids are groups (`TauCeti.AlgHom.instGroup`), so this is automatically an isomorphism of groups.
code:
@[expose] noncomputable def pointsMulEquiv :
    WithConv ((H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) →ₐ[R] A) ≃* WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A) × WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A) where

label: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.pointsMulEquiv_apply
code:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_apply (f : WithConv ((H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) →ₐ[R] A)) :
    pointsMulEquiv f =
      (AlgHom.mapDomain includeLeft f, AlgHom.mapDomain includeRight f) := rfl

label: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.pointsMulEquiv_mapValue
docstring: The product-points equivalence is natural in the value algebra. Post-composing an `A`-valued point of `Spec (H₁ ⊗[R] H₂)` by `φ : A →ₐ[R] B`, then splitting it into its two factor points, gives the same pair as first splitting and then post-composing each factor point by `φ`.
code:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (f : WithConv ((H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) →ₐ[R] A)) :
    pointsMulEquiv (A := B) (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) φ f) =
      (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₁) φ (pointsMulEquiv f).1,
        AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₂) φ (pointsMulEquiv f).2) :=

label: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.pointsMulEquiv_mapValue_fst
docstring: First-component form of `pointsMulEquiv_mapValue`.
code:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_mapValue_fst (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (f : WithConv ((H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) →ₐ[R] A)) :
    (pointsMulEquiv (A := B) (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) φ f)).1 =
      AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₁) φ (pointsMulEquiv f).1 := by

label: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.pointsMulEquiv_mapValue_snd
docstring: Second-component form of `pointsMulEquiv_mapValue`.
code:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_mapValue_snd (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (f : WithConv ((H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) →ₐ[R] A)) :
    (pointsMulEquiv (A := B) (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) φ f)).2 =
      AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₂) φ (pointsMulEquiv f).2 := by

label: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
code:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
    (p : WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A) × WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) :
    pointsMulEquiv.symm p = toConv (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap p.1.ofConv p.2.ofConv) :=

label: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.pointsMulEquiv_symm_mapValue_apply_tmul
docstring: On pure tensors, assembling after post-composing both factor points multiplies the two post-composed factor values.
code:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_symm_mapValue_apply_tmul (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (p : WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A) × WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) (x : H₁) (y : H₂) :
    ((pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂) (A := B)).symm
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₁) φ p.1, AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₂) φ p.2)).ofConv
        (x ⊗ₜ[R] y) =
      φ (p.1.ofConv x) * φ (p.2.ofConv y) := by

label: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.productMap_restrict
docstring: A point of `Spec (H₁ ⊗[R] H₂)` is recovered from its two restrictions by Mathlib's `Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap`.
code:
theorem productMap_restrict (g : (H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) →ₐ[R] A) :
    Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap (g.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft)
        (g.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight) =
      g := by

label: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.restrictHom
docstring: Restriction of a point of `Spec (H₁ ⊗[R] H₂)` to its two factors, as a monoid homomorphism of convolution monoids: it pre-composes with the two inclusions `includeLeft` and `includeRight`. Each component is `TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomain` of a bialgebra morphism, hence a monoid homomorphism, so their pairing is too.
code:
@[expose] noncomputable def restrictHom :
    WithConv ((H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) →ₐ[R] A) →*
      WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A) × WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A) :=

label: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.restrictHom_apply
code:
theorem restrictHom_apply (f : WithConv ((H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) →ₐ[R] A)) :
    restrictHom f = (AlgHom.mapDomain includeLeft f, AlgHom.mapDomain includeRight f) := rfl

label: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.restrictHom_mapValue
docstring: Restricting a product point to the two factors commutes with post-composition in the value algebra. This is the naturality square for the restriction homomorphism underlying `pointsMulEquiv`.
code:
theorem restrictHom_mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (f : WithConv ((H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) →ₐ[R] A)) :
    restrictHom (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) φ f) =
      (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₁) φ (restrictHom f).1,
        AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₂) φ (restrictHom f).2) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.IsArithFrobAt.apply_sqrt
docstring: **An arithmetic Frobenius acts on square roots by the Legendre symbol.** Let `S` be a domain, `Q` an ideal of `S` over the odd rational prime `p`, and `φ : S →ₐ[ℤ] S` an arithmetic Frobenius at `Q`. If `x² = d` for an integer `d` not divisible by `p`, then `φ x = legendreSym p d • x`: the Frobenius fixes `√d` when `d` is a quadratic residue mod `p` and negates it otherwise. (Primality of `Q` is not needed: the sign separation comes from `S` being a domain and `Q ∩ ℤ = (p)`.)
code:
theorem AlgHom.IsArithFrobAt.apply_sqrt {φ : S →ₐ[ℤ] S} (H : φ.IsArithFrobAt Q)
    [Q.LiesOver (span {(p : ℤ)})] (hodd : p ≠ 2) (hd : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ d)
    (hx : x ^ 2 = algebraMap ℤ S d) :
    φ x = legendreSym p d • x := by

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.IsArithFrobAt.sub_legendreSym_smul_mem
docstring: The **Frobenius congruence for a square root, refined by Euler's criterion**: for an arithmetic Frobenius `φ : S →ₐ[ℤ] S` at `Q` lying over the odd rational prime `p`, if `x² = d` then `φ x ≡ legendreSym p d • x (mod Q)`. Internal step of `apply_sqrt`.

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.IsArithFrobAt.sub_pow_mem
docstring: The base Frobenius congruence over a rational prime: for an arithmetic Frobenius `φ : S →ₐ[ℤ] S` at an ideal `Q` lying over `(p)`, `φ y ≡ y ^ p (mod Q)`, the exponent being `p`, the cardinality of the base residue ring `ℤ ⧸ Q ∩ ℤ`. Internal plumbing for `apply_sqrt`.
code:
private theorem AlgHom.IsArithFrobAt.sub_pow_mem {φ : S →ₐ[ℤ] S} (H : φ.IsArithFrobAt Q)
    [Q.LiesOver (span {(p : ℤ)})] (y : S) : φ y - y ^ p ∈ Q := by

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.antipodeComp
docstring: Post-composition of an algebra homomorphism `f : H →ₐ[R] A` with the antipode `S` of `H`, as an `R`-algebra homomorphism `H →ₐ[R] A`. Its underlying linear map is `f.toLinearMap ∘ₗ HopfAlgebra.antipode R`. This is well-defined even when `H` is noncommutative: `S` is an antihomomorphism (`HopfAlgebra.antipode_mul_antidistrib`), and `A` is commutative, so `f ∘ S` is a homomorphism.
code: @[expose] noncomputable def antipodeComp (f : H →ₐ[R] A) : H →ₐ[R] A :=

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv
docstring: Base change of bialgebra points is a monoid isomorphism for the convolution product. The forward direction sends `f : A →ₐ[k] R` to `s ⊗ a ↦ s • f a`; the inverse restricts a `K`-algebra map `K ⊗[k] A →ₐ[K] R` along `a ↦ 1 ⊗ a`.
code:
@[expose] noncomputable def baseChangePointsMulEquiv :
    WithConv (A →ₐ[k] R) ≃* WithConv (K ⊗[k] A →ₐ[K] R) :=

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply_ofConv
docstring: The base-change convolution-monoid isomorphism sends `f` to `s ⊗ a ↦ s • f a`.
code:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply_ofConv (f : WithConv (A →ₐ[k] R)) :
    (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R) f).ofConv =
      AlgHom.liftEquiv k K A R f.ofConv :=

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply_tmul
docstring: The base-change convolution-monoid isomorphism sends `f` to `s ⊗ a ↦ s • f a`.
code:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply_tmul (f : WithConv (A →ₐ[k] R)) (s : K) (a : A) :
    baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R) f (s ⊗ₜ[k] a) =
      s • f.ofConv a :=

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_inv_apply_tmul
docstring: Pointwise inverse formula after base change: on a pure tensor `s ⊗ a`, the convolution inverse of a base-changed point has value `s • f (S a)`. The `≃*` `AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv` is automatically a group isomorphism here, since `A` is a Hopf algebra; this records the value of an inverse point on pure tensors.
code:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_inv_apply_tmul (f : WithConv (A →ₐ[k] R)) (s : K) (a : A) :
    (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R) f)⁻¹ (s ⊗ₜ[k] a) =
      s • f.ofConv (antipode k a) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapDomain
docstring: Base change of points is natural in the coordinate bialgebra. Pre-composing a `B`-point by a bialgebra morphism `φ : A →ₐc[k] B` and then base-changing agrees with first base-changing the point and then pre-composing by the scalar extension `K ⊗[k] A →ₐc[K] K ⊗[k] B`.
code:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapDomain (φ : A →ₐc[k] B)
    (f : WithConv (B →ₐ[k] R)) :
    baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R)
        (mapDomain (A := R) φ f) =
      mapDomain (A := R)
        (_root_.Bialgebra.TensorProduct.map (_root_.BialgHom.id K K) φ)
        (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := B) (R := R) f) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapDomain_apply_tmul
docstring: Pointwise form of `AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapDomain` on pure tensors.
code:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapDomain_apply_tmul (φ : A →ₐc[k] B)
    (f : WithConv (B →ₐ[k] R)) (s : K) (a : A) :
    baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R)
        (mapDomain (A := R) φ f) (s ⊗ₜ[k] a) =
      s • f.ofConv (φ a) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
docstring: The inverse of the base-change convolution-monoid isomorphism restricts along `a ↦ 1 ⊗ a`.
code:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (f : WithConv (K ⊗[k] A →ₐ[K] R)) (a : A) :
    ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R)).symm f).ofConv a =
      f.ofConv (1 ⊗ₜ[k] a) :=

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_inv_apply
docstring: Pointwise inverse formula after restricting a base-changed point along `a ↦ 1 ⊗ a`: the inverse of `(e.symm f)` has value `f (1 ⊗ S a)` at `a`.
code:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_inv_apply (f : WithConv (K ⊗[k] A →ₐ[K] R)) (a : A) :
    (((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R)).symm f)⁻¹).ofConv a =
      f.ofConv (1 ⊗ₜ[k] antipode k a) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_mapDomain
docstring: The inverse direction of base change is natural in the coordinate bialgebra. Restricting along `a ↦ 1 ⊗ a` after pre-composing with the scalar extension of `φ` agrees with first restricting and then pre-composing by `φ`.
code:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_mapDomain (φ : A →ₐc[k] B)
    (f : WithConv (K ⊗[k] B →ₐ[K] R)) :
    (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R)).symm
        (mapDomain (A := R)
          (_root_.Bialgebra.TensorProduct.map (_root_.BialgHom.id K K) φ) f) =
      mapDomain (A := R) φ
        ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := B) (R := R)).symm f) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_mapDomain_apply
docstring: Pointwise form of `AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_mapDomain`.
code:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_mapDomain_apply (φ : A →ₐc[k] B)
    (f : WithConv (K ⊗[k] B →ₐ[K] R)) (a : A) :
    ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R)).symm
        (mapDomain (A := R)
          (_root_.Bialgebra.TensorProduct.map (_root_.BialgHom.id K K) φ) f)).ofConv a =
      f.ofConv (1 ⊗ₜ[k] φ a) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_mapValue
docstring: The inverse direction of base change is natural in the value algebra. Restricting a post-composed base-changed point along `a ↦ 1 ⊗ a` agrees with post-composing the restricted point.
code:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_mapValue (φ : R →ₐ[K] S)
    (f : WithConv (K ⊗[k] A →ₐ[K] R)) :
    (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := S)).symm
        (mapValue (H := K ⊗[k] A) φ f) =
      mapValue (H := A) (φ.restrictScalars k)
        ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R)).symm f) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_ofConv
docstring: The inverse base-change convolution-monoid isomorphism is restriction along `A → K ⊗[k] A`.
code:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_ofConv (f : WithConv (K ⊗[k] A →ₐ[K] R)) :
    ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R)).symm f).ofConv =
      (AlgHom.liftEquiv k K A R).symm f.ofConv :=

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.convInv_apply
docstring: Pointwise, the convolution inverse of `f` sends `h` to `f (S h)`, where `S` is the antipode.
code:
lemma convInv_apply (f : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A)) (h : H) :
    f⁻¹ h = f.ofConv (antipode R h) := rfl

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.convInv_def
docstring: The convolution inverse of `f` is `f ∘ S`, where `S` is the antipode: definitionally, `f⁻¹ = toConv (antipodeComp f.ofConv)`. Kept private as an implementation detail of the group instance; the public pointwise characterization is `convInv_apply`.
code:
private lemma convInv_def (f : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A)) :
    f⁻¹ = toConv (antipodeComp f.ofConv) := rfl

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.convMul_comp_bialgHom_distrib_of_semiring_source
code:
private lemma convMul_comp_bialgHom_distrib_of_semiring_source
    (f g : WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) (φ : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂) :
    AlgHom.comp (f * g).ofConv (φ : H₁ →ₐ[R] H₂) =
      ofConv (toConv (f.ofConv.comp φ) * toConv (g.ofConv.comp φ)) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.instCommGroup
docstring: When `H` is moreover cocommutative, the convolution group of `R`-algebra homomorphisms `H →ₐ[R] A` is abelian.
code: noncomputable instance instCommGroup : CommGroup (WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A)) where

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.instGroup
docstring: For a Hopf algebra `H` over `R` and a commutative `R`-algebra `A`, the convolution monoid of `R`-algebra homomorphisms `H →ₐ[R] A` is a group, with inverse `f ↦ f ∘ S`. When `H` is moreover commutative, `Spec H` is an affine group scheme and this is the group structure on its functor of points evaluated at `A`.
code: noncomputable instance instGroup : Group (WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A)) where

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.instInv
docstring: The convolution inverse of an `R`-algebra homomorphism `f : H →ₐ[R] A` out of a Hopf algebra is `f ∘ S`, where `S` is the antipode.
code: noncomputable instance instInv : Inv (WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A)) where

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.liftEquiv_map_mul
code:
private lemma liftEquiv_map_mul
    (f g : WithConv (A →ₐ[k] R)) :
    AlgHom.liftEquiv k K A R
      (WithConv.ofConv (f * g)) =
    WithConv.ofConv
      ((WithConv.toConv (AlgHom.liftEquiv k K A R f.ofConv) *
        WithConv.toConv (AlgHom.liftEquiv k K A R g.ofConv)) :
          WithConv (K ⊗[k] A →ₐ[K] R)) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomain
docstring: Contravariant functoriality of convolution algebra homomorphisms in the source bialgebra. A bialgebra morphism `φ : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂` sends an `A`-valued point of `H₂` to an `A`-valued point of `H₁` by pre-composition.
code:
@[expose] noncomputable def mapDomain (φ : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂) :
    WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A) →* WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A) where

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomainMulEquiv
docstring: A bialgebra isomorphism `e : H₁ ≃ₐc[R] H₂` induces a multiplicative equivalence of the convolution monoids of points, by pre-composition: the equiv-version of the contravariant functoriality `mapDomain`.
code:
@[expose] noncomputable def mapDomainMulEquiv (e : H₁ ≃ₐc[R] H₂) :
    WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A) ≃* WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A) where

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomainMulEquiv_apply
docstring: `mapDomainMulEquiv` acts by the underlying `mapDomain` in the forward direction.
code:
lemma mapDomainMulEquiv_apply (e : H₁ ≃ₐc[R] H₂) (f : WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) :
    mapDomainMulEquiv e f = mapDomain (e : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂) f := rfl

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomainMulEquiv_symm_apply
docstring: `mapDomainMulEquiv` acts by pre-composition with the inverse bialgebra equivalence in the reverse direction.
code:
lemma mapDomainMulEquiv_symm_apply (e : H₁ ≃ₐc[R] H₂) (f : WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A)) :
    (mapDomainMulEquiv (A := A) e).symm f = mapDomain (e.symm : H₂ →ₐc[R] H₁) f := rfl

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomain_apply
docstring: `mapDomain φ` acts pointwise by pre-composition with `φ`.
code:
lemma mapDomain_apply (φ : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂) (f : WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) :
    mapDomain φ f = toConv (f.ofConv.comp (φ : H₁ →ₐ[R] H₂)) := rfl

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomain_apply_apply
docstring: Pointwise form of `mapDomain_apply`.
code:
lemma mapDomain_apply_apply (φ : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂) (f : WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) (h : H₁) :
    mapDomain φ f h = f.ofConv (φ h) := rfl

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomain_comp
docstring: Pre-composition by a composite bialgebra morphism is the composite of the corresponding pre-composition maps.
code:
lemma mapDomain_comp (ψ : H₂ →ₐc[R] H₃) (φ : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂) :
    (mapDomain (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₃) (ψ.comp φ) :
        WithConv (H₃ →ₐ[R] A) →* WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A)) =
      (mapDomain (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂) φ :
          WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A) →* WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A)).comp
        (mapDomain (H₁ := H₂) (H₂ := H₃) ψ :
          WithConv (H₃ →ₐ[R] A) →* WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomain_id
docstring: Pre-composition by the identity bialgebra morphism is the identity map on the convolution monoid.
code:
lemma mapDomain_id :
    (mapDomain (BialgHom.id R H₁) : WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A) →* WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A)) =
      MonoidHom.id (WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A)) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomain_inv_apply
docstring: The inverse in the target convolution group is transported by `mapDomain` pointwise as pre-composition with the bialgebra morphism. The group homomorphism statement follows from `mapDomain` being a `MonoidHom`; this lemma records the concrete formula used at points.
code:
lemma mapDomain_inv_apply (φ : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂) (f : WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) (h : H₁) :
    mapDomain (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂) φ (f⁻¹ : WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) h =
      f.ofConv (HopfAlgebra.antipode R (φ h)) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapValue
docstring: Functoriality of `A ↦ (H →ₐ[R] A)` in the value algebra: an `R`-algebra homomorphism `φ : A →ₐ[R] B` induces, by post-composition, a monoid homomorphism between the convolution monoids. This needs only the bialgebra structure on `H`. When `H` is moreover a Hopf algebra, these convolution monoids are the convolution groups (`instGroup`); a `MonoidHom` between groups is automatically a group homomorphism, so no separate construction is needed there.
code:
@[expose] noncomputable def mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A) →* WithConv (H →ₐ[R] B) where

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapValue_apply
docstring: `mapValue φ` acts pointwise by post-composition: `(mapValue φ f) = φ ∘ f`.
code:
lemma mapValue_apply (φ : A →ₐ[R] B) (f : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A)) :
    mapValue φ f = toConv (φ.comp f.ofConv) := rfl

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapValue_baseChangePointsMulEquiv
docstring: Base change of points is natural in the value algebra. Post-composing an `R`-valued point by a `K`-algebra homomorphism `φ : R →ₐ[K] S` and then base-changing agrees with first base-changing the point and then post-composing by `φ`.
code:
lemma mapValue_baseChangePointsMulEquiv (φ : R →ₐ[K] S)
    (f : WithConv (A →ₐ[k] R)) :
    mapValue (H := K ⊗[k] A) φ
        (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := R) f) =
      baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (R := S)
        (mapValue (H := A) (φ.restrictScalars k) f) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapValue_comp
docstring: `mapValue` preserves composition: `mapValue (ψ ∘ φ) = mapValue ψ ∘ mapValue φ`.
code:
lemma mapValue_comp (ψ : B →ₐ[R] C) (φ : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    mapValue (H := H) (ψ.comp φ) = (mapValue ψ).comp (mapValue φ) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapValue_id
docstring: `mapValue` preserves the identity: `mapValue (𝟙 A)` is the identity monoid homomorphism.
code:
lemma mapValue_id :
    mapValue (H := H) (AlgHom.id R A) = MonoidHom.id (WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A)) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapValue_mapDomain
docstring: Pre-composition in the coordinate bialgebra commutes with post-composition in the value algebra.
code:
lemma mapValue_mapDomain (φ : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂) (χ : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    (mapDomain (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂) φ :
        WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] B) →* WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] B)).comp
        (mapValue (H := H₂) χ) =
      (mapValue (H := H₁) χ).comp
        (mapDomain (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂) φ :
          WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A) →* WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A)) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgHom.toLinearMap_antipodeComp
code:
private lemma toLinearMap_antipodeComp (f : H →ₐ[R] A) :
    (antipodeComp f).toLinearMap = f.toLinearMap ∘ₗ antipode R := rfl

label: TauCeti.Algebra.TensorProduct.comp_productMap
TauCeti.Algebra.discr_one_elem_eq_of_sq_algebraMap
docstring: For a quadratic extension `L / F` and an element `x ∉ F` whose square is `a ∈ F`, the trace-form discriminant of the square-root basis `{1, x}` equals `4 a`.
code:
theorem discr_one_elem_eq_of_sq_algebraMap {x : L} {a : F} (hfin : finrank F L = 2)
    (hx2 : x ^ 2 = algebraMap F L a) (hx : x ∉ (algebraMap F L).range) :
    Algebra.discr F ![1, x] = 4 * a := by

label: TauCeti.Algebra.trace_eq_zero_of_sq_algebraMap_of_not_mem_range
docstring: In a finite field extension, an element outside the base field whose square lies in the base field has trace zero.
code:
theorem trace_eq_zero_of_sq_algebraMap_of_not_mem_range {F L : Type*} [Field F] [Field L]
    [Algebra F L] [FiniteDimensional F L] {x : L} {r : F}
    (hx2 : x ^ 2 = algebraMap F L r) (hx : x ∉ (algebraMap F L).range) :
    Algebra.trace F L x = 0 := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety
docstring: An **abelian variety** over a field `K`: a proper geometrically integral group scheme over `Spec K`. The group-object structure lives on `toOver : Over (Spec (.of K))`; the underlying scheme is `toScheme = toOver.left`. The fields are the standing hypotheses of the theory: `grpObj` is the group law, `isProper` says the structure morphism to `Spec K` is proper, and `geometricallyIntegral` records the geometric hypothesis from which smoothness, geometric connectedness, absolute integrality, and commutativity are derived.
code: structure AbelianVariety (K : Type u) [Field K] where

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.baseChange
docstring: Base change of a homomorphism of abelian varieties along a field extension. This is the morphism obtained by applying pullback in the appropriate `Over` category. The monoidal structure on pullback ensures that it is again a group-scheme homomorphism.
code:
noncomputable def Hom.baseChange {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] : A.baseChange L ⟶ B.baseChange L := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.baseChange_comp
docstring: Base change preserves composition of homomorphisms.
code:
lemma Hom.baseChange_comp {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.baseChange (f ≫ g) L = Hom.baseChange f L ≫ Hom.baseChange g L := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.baseChange_id
docstring: Base change preserves identity homomorphisms.
code:
lemma Hom.baseChange_id (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.baseChange (𝟙 A) L = 𝟙 (A.baseChange L) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.comp_div
docstring: Pre-composition preserves pointwise quotients of homomorphisms.
code:
@[simp] lemma comp_div {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g h : B ⟶ C) :
    f ≫ (g / h) = (f ≫ g) / (f ≫ h) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.comp_inv
docstring: Pre-composition preserves pointwise inverses of homomorphisms.
code:
@[simp] lemma comp_inv {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) :
    f ≫ g⁻¹ = (f ≫ g)⁻¹ := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.comp_mul
docstring: Composition of homomorphisms of abelian varieties distributes over the pointwise product on the left: pre-composition by a homomorphism is multiplicative.
code:
@[simp, reassoc] lemma comp_mul {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g h : B ⟶ C) :
    f ≫ (g * h) = f ≫ g * f ≫ h := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.comp_one
docstring: Pre-composition sends the identity element of a homomorphism group to the identity element.
code:
@[simp] lemma comp_one {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    f ≫ (1 : B ⟶ C) = 1 := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.div_comp
docstring: Post-composition preserves pointwise quotients of homomorphisms.
code:
@[simp] lemma div_comp {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f g : A ⟶ B) (h : B ⟶ C) :
    (f / g) ≫ h = (f ≫ h) / (g ≫ h) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.ext
docstring: Two homomorphisms of abelian varieties are equal when their underlying scheme morphisms are equal.
code:
lemma Hom.ext {A B : AbelianVariety K} {f g : A ⟶ B}
    (h : Hom.toSchemeHom f = Hom.toSchemeHom g) : f = g := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.homMulEquiv
docstring: Identifying a homomorphism of abelian varieties with its underlying homomorphism of commutative group objects is a group isomorphism onto the latter's group of homomorphisms.
code:
def homMulEquiv (A B : AbelianVariety K) :
    (A ⟶ B) ≃* ((CommGrp.mk A.toOver).toGrp ⟶ (CommGrp.mk B.toOver).toGrp) where

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.homMulEquiv_apply
docstring: The hom-set multiplicative equivalence evaluates to the nested underlying group-object homomorphism.
code:
@[simp] lemma homMulEquiv_apply (f : A ⟶ B) :
    homMulEquiv A B f = f.hom.hom := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.instCommGroup
docstring: Homomorphisms of abelian varieties over `K` form a commutative group under the pointwise group law of the target, transported from Mathlib's group structure on morphisms into a commutative group object.
code: scoped instance instCommGroup (A B : AbelianVariety K) : CommGroup (A ⟶ B) :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.inv_comp
docstring: Post-composition preserves pointwise inverses of homomorphisms.
code:
@[simp] lemma inv_comp {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (h : B ⟶ C) :
    f⁻¹ ≫ h = (f ≫ h)⁻¹ := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.inv_hom
docstring: A homomorphism of abelian varieties preserves inverses.
code:
lemma Hom.inv_hom {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    ι[A.toOver] ≫ Hom.toOverHom f = Hom.toOverHom f ≫ ι[B.toOver] := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.mk'
docstring: Construct a homomorphism of abelian varieties from a morphism over `Spec K` and proofs that it preserves the unit and multiplication.

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.mul_comp
docstring: Composition of homomorphisms of abelian varieties distributes over the pointwise product on the right: post-composition by a homomorphism is multiplicative.
code:
@[simp, reassoc] lemma mul_comp {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f g : A ⟶ B) (h : B ⟶ C) :
    (f * g) ≫ h = f ≫ h * g ≫ h := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.mul_hom
docstring: A homomorphism of abelian varieties preserves multiplication.
code:
lemma Hom.mul_hom {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    μ[A.toOver] ≫ Hom.toOverHom f =
      (Hom.toOverHom f ⊗ₘ Hom.toOverHom f) ≫ μ[B.toOver] := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.one_comp
docstring: Post-composition sends the identity element of a homomorphism group to the identity element.
code:
@[simp] lemma one_comp {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (h : B ⟶ C) :
    (1 : A ⟶ B) ≫ h = 1 := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.one_hom
docstring: A homomorphism of abelian varieties preserves the unit section.
code:
lemma Hom.one_hom {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    η[A.toOver] ≫ Hom.toOverHom f = η[B.toOver] := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverFunctor
docstring: The forgetful functor from abelian varieties to schemes over `Spec K`.
code:
@[expose] noncomputable def Hom.toOverFunctor :
    AbelianVariety K ⥤ Over (Spec (.of K)) :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom
docstring: The underlying morphism of group schemes over `Spec K`.
code: abbrev Hom.toOverHom {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) : A.toOver ⟶ B.toOver :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_baseChange
docstring: The underlying morphism over `Spec L` of a base-changed homomorphism is the pullback of its underlying morphism over `Spec K`.
code:
lemma Hom.toOverHom_baseChange {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.toOverHom (Hom.baseChange f L) =
      eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L) ≫
        (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).map
          (Hom.toOverHom f) ≫
        eqToHom (baseChange_toOver B L).symm := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_comp
docstring: `toOverHom` sends composition to composition over `Spec K`.
code:
lemma Hom.toOverHom_comp {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) :
    Hom.toOverHom (f ≫ g) = Hom.toOverHom f ≫ Hom.toOverHom g :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_def
docstring: `toOverHom` is definitionally the iterated underlying-morphism projection through the two induced categories, `CommGrp`, and `Grp`.
code:
private lemma Hom.toOverHom_def {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    Hom.toOverHom f = f.hom.hom.hom.hom :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_div
docstring: The underlying morphism over `Spec K` sends the quotient of two homomorphisms to the pointwise quotient.
code:
@[simp] lemma toOverHom_div (f g : A ⟶ B) :
    toOverHom (f / g) = toOverHom f / toOverHom g := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_eq_homMulEquiv
docstring: The underlying morphism over `Spec K` of a homomorphism of abelian varieties is the underlying morphism of the corresponding commutative-group-object homomorphism.
code:
private lemma toOverHom_eq_homMulEquiv (f : A ⟶ B) :
    toOverHom f = (homMulEquiv A B f).hom.hom := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_id
docstring: `toOverHom` sends the identity homomorphism to the identity over `Spec K`.
code: lemma Hom.toOverHom_id (A : AbelianVariety K) : Hom.toOverHom (𝟙 A) = 𝟙 A.toOver :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_inv
docstring: The underlying morphism over `Spec K` sends the inverse of a homomorphism to the pointwise inverse.
code:
@[simp] lemma toOverHom_inv (f : A ⟶ B) :
    toOverHom f⁻¹ = (toOverHom f)⁻¹ := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_mk'
docstring: The underlying morphism over `Spec K` of a homomorphism built by `Hom.mk'` is the supplied morphism.
code:
lemma Hom.toOverHom_mk' {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A.toOver ⟶ B.toOver)
    (one_f : η[A.toOver] ≫ f = η[B.toOver] := by cat_disch)
    (mul_f : μ[A.toOver] ≫ f = (f ⊗ₘ f) ≫ μ[B.toOver] := by cat_disch) :
    Hom.toOverHom (Hom.mk' f one_f mul_f) = f :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_mul
docstring: The underlying morphism over `Spec K` sends the product of two homomorphisms to the pointwise product.
code:
@[simp] lemma toOverHom_mul (f g : A ⟶ B) :
    toOverHom (f * g) = toOverHom f * toOverHom g := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_one
docstring: The underlying morphism over `Spec K` sends the identity of the group of homomorphisms to the identity element `toUnit A.toOver ≫ η[B.toOver]` (the constant homomorphism through the unit section).
code:
@[simp] lemma toOverHom_one :
    toOverHom (1 : A ⟶ B) = 1 := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toSchemeHom
docstring: The underlying morphism between the schemes of two abelian varieties.
code: abbrev Hom.toSchemeHom {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) : A.toScheme ⟶ B.toScheme :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toSchemeHom_baseChange
docstring: The underlying scheme morphism of a base-changed homomorphism is the left component of the pulled-back morphism in the `Over` category.
code:
lemma Hom.toSchemeHom_baseChange {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.toSchemeHom (Hom.baseChange f L) =
      (eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L) ≫
        (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).map
          (Hom.toOverHom f) ≫
        eqToHom (baseChange_toOver B L).symm).left :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toSchemeHom_comp
docstring: `toSchemeHom` sends composition to composition of scheme morphisms.
code:
lemma Hom.toSchemeHom_comp {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) :
    Hom.toSchemeHom (f ≫ g) = Hom.toSchemeHom f ≫ Hom.toSchemeHom g :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toSchemeHom_comp_hom
code:
lemma Hom.toSchemeHom_comp_hom {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    Hom.toSchemeHom f ≫ B.toOver.hom = A.toOver.hom :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toSchemeHom_id
docstring: `toSchemeHom` sends the identity homomorphism to the identity scheme morphism.
code:
lemma Hom.toSchemeHom_id (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    Hom.toSchemeHom (𝟙 A) = 𝟙 A.toScheme :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toSchemeHom_mk'
docstring: The underlying scheme morphism of a homomorphism built by `Hom.mk'` is the supplied morphism's left component.
code:
lemma Hom.toSchemeHom_mk' {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A.toOver ⟶ B.toOver)
    (one_f : η[A.toOver] ≫ f = η[B.toOver] := by cat_disch)
    (mul_f : μ[A.toOver] ≫ f = (f ⊗ₘ f) ≫ μ[B.toOver] := by cat_disch) :
    Hom.toSchemeHom (Hom.mk' f one_f mul_f) = f.left := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChange
docstring: The base change of an abelian variety along a field extension `K → L`, obtained by pulling back the group scheme along `Spec L → Spec K`. Properness and geometric integrality are stable under base change, and the monoidal pullback functor carries the group-object structure (`Functor.grpObjObj`), so the result is again an abelian variety. This realizes the roadmap's base-change compatibility of the Jacobian at the level of abelian varieties.
code:
noncomputable def baseChange (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L]
    [Algebra K L] : AbelianVariety L where

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChangeFunctor
docstring: Extension of the base field defines a functor between the categories of abelian varieties.
code:
noncomputable def baseChangeFunctor (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    AbelianVariety K ⥤ AbelianVariety L where

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChangeFunctor_map
code:
lemma baseChangeFunctor_map {A B : AbelianVariety K} (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (f : A ⟶ B) :
    (baseChangeFunctor L).map f =
      eqToHom (baseChangeFunctor_obj L A) ≫ Hom.baseChange f L ≫
        eqToHom (baseChangeFunctor_obj L B).symm :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChangeFunctor_obj
code:
lemma baseChangeFunctor_obj (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    (baseChangeFunctor L).obj A = A.baseChange L :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChange_dim
code:
lemma baseChange_dim (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    (A.baseChange L).dim =
      topologicalKrullDim
        (Limits.pullback A.toOver.hom
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) : Scheme.{u}) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChange_inv
docstring: The inverse of a base-changed abelian variety is the pullback of the original inverse.
code:
lemma baseChange_inv (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    ι[(A.baseChange L).toOver] ≫ eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L) =
      eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L) ≫
      (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).map ι[A.toOver] :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChange_mul
docstring: The multiplication of a base-changed abelian variety is the pullback of the original multiplication, with the monoidal comparison for `Over.pullback`.
code:
lemma baseChange_mul (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    μ[(A.baseChange L).toOver] ≫ eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L) =
      (eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L) ⊗ₘ eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L)) ≫
        Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ
        (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))) A.toOver A.toOver ≫
        (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).map μ[A.toOver] :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChange_one
docstring: The unit of a base-changed abelian variety is the pullback of the original unit, with the monoidal comparison for `Over.pullback`.
code:
lemma baseChange_one (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    η[(A.baseChange L).toOver] ≫ eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L) =
      Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε
        (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))) ≫
        (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).map η[A.toOver] :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChange_toOver
code:
lemma baseChange_toOver (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    (A.baseChange L).toOver =
      (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).obj A.toOver :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChange_toScheme
docstring: The underlying scheme of a base change is the fibre product of the abelian variety with `Spec L` over `Spec K`.
code:
lemma baseChange_toScheme (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    (A.baseChange L).toScheme =
      Limits.pullback A.toOver.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.commGrpMk_baseChange_toOver
docstring: Bundling the underlying `Over` object of a base change with `CommGrp.mk` gives the commutative group object obtained by applying pullback.
code:
lemma commGrpMk_baseChange_toOver (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    CommGrp.mk (A.baseChange L).toOver =
      (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).mapCommGrp.obj
        (CommGrp.mk A.toOver) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.dim
docstring: The dimension of an abelian variety, defined as the topological Krull dimension of its underlying scheme.
code: noncomputable abbrev dim (A : AbelianVariety K) : WithBot ℕ∞ :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.dim_def
code:
lemma dim_def (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    A.dim = topologicalKrullDim A.toScheme :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.dim_eq_of_iso
docstring: Isomorphic abelian varieties have equal topological Krull dimension.
code:
lemma dim_eq_of_iso {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) :
    A.dim = B.dim :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.geometricallyConnected
docstring: An abelian variety is geometrically connected over the base field.
code:
instance geometricallyConnected (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    GeometricallyConnected A.toOver.hom :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isCommMonObj
docstring: The group law of an abelian variety is commutative: a proper geometrically integral group scheme over a field is a commutative group object. This is the abstract rigidity theorem `AlgebraicGeometry.isCommMonObj_of_isProper_of_geometricallyIntegral`, packaged for the bundled `AbelianVariety`.
code: instance isCommMonObj (A : AbelianVariety K) : IsCommMonObj A.toOver :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isIntegral
docstring: The underlying scheme of an abelian variety is integral: geometric integrality over the one-point base `Spec K` descends to absolute integrality. In particular the underlying space is nonempty, irreducible, and reduced.
code: instance isIntegral (A : AbelianVariety K) : IsIntegral A.toScheme :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToOver
docstring: The isomorphism of schemes over `Spec K` underlying an isomorphism of abelian varieties.
code: def isoToOver {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) : A.toOver ≅ B.toOver :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToOver_hom
docstring: The forward map of the underlying `Over` isomorphism is the underlying homomorphism.
code:
lemma isoToOver_hom {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) :
    (isoToOver e).hom = Hom.toOverHom e.hom := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToOver_inv
docstring: The inverse map of the underlying `Over` isomorphism is the underlying homomorphism.
code:
lemma isoToOver_inv {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) :
    (isoToOver e).inv = Hom.toOverHom e.inv := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToOver_refl
docstring: The underlying `Over` isomorphism of the identity isomorphism is the identity.
code:
lemma isoToOver_refl (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    isoToOver (Iso.refl A) = Iso.refl A.toOver :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToOver_symm
docstring: Forgetting an inverse isomorphism over the base commutes with taking inverses.
code:
lemma isoToOver_symm {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) :
    isoToOver e.symm = (isoToOver e).symm := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToOver_trans
docstring: Forgetting a composite isomorphism over the base commutes with composition.
code:
lemma isoToOver_trans {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) (f : B ≅ C) :
    isoToOver (e.trans f) = (isoToOver e).trans (isoToOver f) :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToScheme
docstring: The isomorphism of schemes underlying an isomorphism of abelian varieties.
code: def isoToScheme {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) : A.toScheme ≅ B.toScheme :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToScheme_hom
docstring: The forward map of the underlying scheme isomorphism is the underlying scheme morphism.
code:
lemma isoToScheme_hom {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) :
    (isoToScheme e).hom = Hom.toSchemeHom e.hom := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToScheme_inv
docstring: The inverse map of the underlying scheme isomorphism is the underlying scheme morphism.
code:
lemma isoToScheme_inv {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) :
    (isoToScheme e).inv = Hom.toSchemeHom e.inv := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToScheme_refl
docstring: The underlying scheme isomorphism of the identity isomorphism is the identity.
code:
lemma isoToScheme_refl (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    isoToScheme (Iso.refl A) = Iso.refl A.toScheme := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToScheme_symm
docstring: Forgetting an inverse isomorphism of schemes commutes with taking inverses.
code:
lemma isoToScheme_symm {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) :
    isoToScheme e.symm = (isoToScheme e).symm := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToScheme_trans
docstring: Forgetting a composite isomorphism of schemes commutes with composition.
code:
lemma isoToScheme_trans {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) (f : B ≅ C) :
    isoToScheme (e.trans f) = (isoToScheme e).trans (isoToScheme f) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.ofGeometricallyIntegral
docstring: A constructor for abelian varieties from Mathlib's geometrically integral package.
code:
noncomputable def ofGeometricallyIntegral (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    [IsProper G.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral G.hom] : AbelianVariety K where

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.ofGeometricallyIntegral_inv
docstring: The inverse of `ofGeometricallyIntegral G` is the inverse of `G`.
code:
lemma ofGeometricallyIntegral_inv (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    [IsProper G.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral G.hom] :
    ι[(ofGeometricallyIntegral G).toOver] ≫
        eqToHom (ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver G) =
      eqToHom (ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver G) ≫ ι[G] := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.ofGeometricallyIntegral_mul
docstring: The multiplication of `ofGeometricallyIntegral G` is the multiplication of `G`.
code:
lemma ofGeometricallyIntegral_mul (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    [IsProper G.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral G.hom] :
    μ[(ofGeometricallyIntegral G).toOver] ≫
        eqToHom (ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver G) =
      (eqToHom (ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver G) ⊗ₘ
          eqToHom (ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver G)) ≫ μ[G] := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.ofGeometricallyIntegral_one
docstring: The unit of `ofGeometricallyIntegral G` is the unit of `G`.
code:
lemma ofGeometricallyIntegral_one (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    [IsProper G.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral G.hom] :
    η[(ofGeometricallyIntegral G).toOver] ≫
        eqToHom (ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver G) = η[G] := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver
code:
lemma ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    [IsProper G.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral G.hom] :
    (ofGeometricallyIntegral G).toOver = G :=

docstring: An abelian variety is smooth over the base field.
code: instance smooth (A : AbelianVariety K) : Smooth A.toOver.hom := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.toScheme
docstring: The underlying scheme of an abelian variety.
code: noncomputable abbrev toScheme (A : AbelianVariety K) : Scheme.{u} :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyConnected.of_geometricallyIrreducible
docstring: A geometrically irreducible morphism is geometrically connected. Kept `private` as an implementation helper for `AbelianVariety.geometricallyConnected`; it is not part of the abelian-variety public interface.
code:
private lemma GeometricallyConnected.of_geometricallyIrreducible {X S : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ S}
    [GeometricallyIrreducible f] : GeometricallyConnected f := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor
docstring: A Weil divisor on a type of points `X` is a finite formal integer sum of points of `X`.
code: abbrev WeilDivisor (X : Type*) : Type _ :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree
docstring: The effective Weil divisors of degree `d`.
code: abbrev EffectiveDivisorOfDegree (X : Type*) (d : ℕ) : Type _ :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.add
docstring: Add fixed-degree effective divisors. The degree index records additivity of degree.
code:
abbrev add (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X (d + e) :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.add_assoc
docstring: Fixed-degree effective-divisor addition is associative, up to the degree-index cast.
code:
lemma add_assoc {n : ℕ} (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) (F : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X n) :
    add (add D E) F =
      EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast (Nat.add_assoc d e n).symm (add D (add E F)) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.add_comm
docstring: Fixed-degree effective-divisor addition is commutative, up to the degree-index cast.
code:
lemma add_comm (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    add D E = EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast (Nat.add_comm e d) (add E D) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.add_ofFinsupp
docstring: Adding divisors built from finitely supported multiplicities corresponds to adding their multiplicity functions.
code:
lemma add_ofFinsupp (m n : X →₀ ℕ) (hm : m.sum (fun _ k => k) = d)
    (hn : n.sum (fun _ k => k) = e) :
    add (ofFinsupp m hm) (ofFinsupp n hn) =
      ofFinsupp (m + n) (by
        rw [Finsupp.sum_add_index']
        · simp [hm, hn]
        · simp
        · simp) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.add_ofSym
docstring: Adding the divisors associated to symmetric-power points is the divisor associated to their appended unordered collection.
code:
lemma add_ofSym (s : Sym X d) (t : Sym X e) :
    add (ofSym s) (ofSym t) = ofSym (s.append t) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.add_subOfLe
docstring: Adding a sub-divisor back to its residual recovers the original divisor, up to the cast identifying `d + (e - d)` with `e`.
code:
lemma add_subOfLe (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d)
    (hED : (E : WeilDivisor X) ≤ D) :
    add E (subOfLe D E hED) =
      EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast
        (Nat.add_sub_of_le (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.degree_le_of_le hED)).symm D := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.add_zero
docstring: Zero is a right identity for fixed-degree effective-divisor addition.
code:
lemma add_zero (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    add D (zero X) = EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast (Nat.add_zero d).symm D := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast
docstring: Change the degree index of a fixed-degree effective divisor along an equality.
code:
protected def cast {d e : ℕ} (h : d = e) :
    EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d ≃ EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e where

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast_rfl
docstring: Changing the degree index along `rfl` leaves a fixed-degree divisor unchanged.
code:
lemma cast_rfl (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast rfl D = D :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_add
docstring: The underlying Weil divisor of a fixed-degree sum is the sum of the underlying divisors.
code:
lemma coe_add (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    (add D E : WeilDivisor X) = (D : WeilDivisor X) + E :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_cast
docstring: Changing the degree index does not change the underlying Weil divisor.
code:
lemma coe_cast {d e : ℕ} (h : d = e) (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast h D : WeilDivisor X) = D := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_inf
code:
lemma coe_inf (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    (inf D E : WeilDivisor X) = (D : WeilDivisor X) ⊓ E :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_leftResidual
code:
lemma coe_leftResidual (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    (leftResidual D E : WeilDivisor X) = (D : WeilDivisor X) - inf D E :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_negPart
docstring: The underlying Weil divisor of the packaged negative part is `D⁻`.
code:
lemma coe_negPart (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    (negPart D : WeilDivisor X) = D⁻ :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_ofFinsupp
code:
lemma coe_ofFinsupp (m : X →₀ ℕ) (hm : m.sum (fun _ n => n) = d) :
    (ofFinsupp m hm : WeilDivisor X) = WeilDivisor.ofFinsupp m :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_ofSym
code:
lemma coe_ofSym (s : Sym X d) :
    (ofSym s : WeilDivisor X) =
      WeilDivisor.ofFinsupp (letI := Classical.decEq X; (Sym.equivNatSum X d s).1) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_ofSym_append
docstring: The divisor associated to an appended symmetric-power point is the sum of the associated fixed-degree divisors.
code:
lemma coe_ofSym_append (s : Sym X d) (t : Sym X e) :
    WeilDivisor.ofFinsupp
        (letI := Classical.decEq X; ((Sym.equivNatSum X (d + e)) (s.append t)).1) =
      (ofSym s : WeilDivisor X) + (ofSym t : WeilDivisor X) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_posPart
docstring: The underlying Weil divisor of the packaged positive part is `D⁺`.
code:
lemma coe_posPart (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    (posPart D : WeilDivisor X) = D⁺ :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.coe_pushforward
code:
lemma coe_pushforward (f : X → Y) (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    (D.pushforward f : WeilDivisor Y) = WeilDivisor.pushforward f D :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem
docstring: An *order system* on a type of points `X` with values in a group `G`: a family of `ℤ`-valued homomorphisms `ord x : G →+ ℤ`, the orders of vanishing at each point, such that every `g : G` vanishes to nonzero order at only finitely many points. label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivDegreeRange
docstring: **The degree quotient.** The class group modulo the abstract `Pic⁰` is isomorphic to the image of the degree, `Cl(X) ⧸ Pic⁰ ≃+ (weightedDegreeClass w h).range`. This is Noether's first isomorphism theorem for the descended weighted degree, whose kernel is `picZero` by definition; the image is `AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range w)` by `weightedDegreeClass_range`. It is the degree quotient of the class group, the divisor-class analogue of `Pic/Pic⁰`; no Picard scheme is constructed here.
code:
@[expose] noncomputable def classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivDegreeRange (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) :
    S.ClassGroup ⧸ picZero w h ≃+ (weightedDegreeClass w h).range :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivDegreeRange_symm_apply
code:
lemma classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivDegreeRange_symm_apply (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) (c : S.ClassGroup) :
    (S.classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivDegreeRange w h).symm
        ⟨weightedDegreeClass w h c, c, rfl⟩ = QuotientAddGroup.mk c := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivInt
docstring: **The degree quotient at a surjective degree.** When the descended weighted degree is surjective — equivalently when the weights generate `ℤ`, see `weightedDegreeClass_range_eq_top` — the class group modulo the abstract `Pic⁰` is `ℤ`, `Cl(X) ⧸ Pic⁰ ≃+ ℤ`. A weight-one base point is the special case `classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivIntOfWeightOne`.
code:
@[expose] noncomputable def classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivInt (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (weightedDegreeClass w h)) : S.ClassGroup ⧸ picZero w h ≃+ ℤ :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivIntOfWeightOne
docstring: **The degree quotient at a weight-one base point.** With a weight-one base point the degree section `n ↦ n • [x₀]` is a genuine right inverse of the descended weighted degree, so the class group modulo the abstract `Pic⁰` is `ℤ`, `Cl(X) ⧸ Pic⁰ ≃+ ℤ`, with an explicit inverse. Together with `DegreeSplitting`'s `Cl(X) ≃+ picZero × ℤ` this exhibits the degree as the projection to the `ℤ` factor.
code:
@[expose] noncomputable def classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivIntOfWeightOne (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) :
    S.ClassGroup ⧸ picZero w h ≃+ ℤ :=

code:
lemma classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivIntOfWeightOne_mk (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)

    S.classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivIntOfWeightOne w h hx₀ (QuotientAddGroup.mk c) =
      weightedDegreeClass w h c :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivIntOfWeightOne_symm_apply
code:
lemma classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivIntOfWeightOne_symm_apply (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (n : ℤ) :
    (S.classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivIntOfWeightOne w h hx₀).symm n =

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivInt_symm_weightedDegreeClass

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeCorrection
docstring: The degree-correction homomorphism `c ↦ c - (weightedDegreeClass w h c) • [x₀]`. With a weight-one base point its image lands in `picZero`, and together with `degreeSection` it splits the class group as `picZero × ℤ`.
code:
noncomputable def degreeCorrection (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) (x₀ : X) :
    S.ClassGroup →+ S.ClassGroup :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeCorrection_apply
code:
lemma degreeCorrection_apply (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) (x₀ : X)

docstring: Changing the base point in the class-group degree correction adds the weighted degree of the class times the base-point-change divisor class.

    (x₀ y₀ : X) (c : S.ClassGroup) :
    S.degreeCorrection w h y₀ c =
      S.degreeCorrection w h x₀ c +
        weightedDegreeClass w h c • S.divisorClass (pointDifference x₀ y₀) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeCorrection_divisorClass

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeCorrection_divisorClass_ofPoint

    S.degreeCorrection w h x₀ (S.divisorClass (ofPoint x)) =

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiClass
docstring: The weighted abstract Abel-Jacobi class of a point. For a geometric weight `w x = [κ(x) : k]` and a rational base point `x₀` (`w x₀ = 1`), this is the class of `[x] - w(x)[x₀]` in the abstract weighted-degree-zero Picard group.
code:
