    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (x : X) : picZero w hdeg :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiClass_base
docstring: The weighted abstract Abel-Jacobi class of the base point is zero.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiClass_base (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ x₀ = 0 := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiClass_change_base
docstring: Changing the Abel-Jacobi base point from `x₀` to `y₀` adds `w x` times the class `[x₀] - [y₀]`. For the geometric specialization, `w x` is the residue-field degree.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiClass_change_base (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ y₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hy₀ : w y₀ = 1) (x : X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hy₀ x =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ x +
      w x • S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg (hx₀.trans hy₀.symm) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiClass_eq_iff_divisorClass
docstring: Equality of weighted Abel-Jacobi classes is equality of the corresponding divisor classes.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiClass_eq_iff_divisorClass (w : X → ℤ)
    (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) {x y : X} :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ x = S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ y ↔
      S.divisorClass (weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x) =
        S.divisorClass (weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ y) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent
docstring: Equality of weighted Abel-Jacobi classes is linear equivalence of the corresponding degree-corrected point divisors.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent (w : X → ℤ)
    (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) {x y : X} :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ x = S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ y ↔
      S.LinearlyEquivalent (weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x)
        (weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ y) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiClass_oldBase_eq_basepointChangeClass
docstring: The base-point-change class is the Abel-Jacobi class of the old base point with respect to the new base point.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiClass_oldBase_eq_basepointChangeClass (w : X → ℤ)
    (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ y₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hy₀ : w y₀ = 1) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hy₀ x₀ =
      S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg (hx₀.trans hy₀.symm) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiClass_sub_change_base_coe
docstring: In the class group, the difference between two weighted Abel-Jacobi classes with different base points is `w(x)` times the class `[x₀] - [y₀]`.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiClass_sub_change_base_coe (w : X → ℤ)
    (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ y₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hy₀ : w y₀ = 1)
    (x : X) :
    (S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hy₀ x : S.ClassGroup) -
        (S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ x : S.ClassGroup) =
      w x • S.divisorClass (pointDifference x₀ y₀) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiClass_sub_coe
docstring: The difference between two weighted Abel-Jacobi classes with the same base point is the class `[x] - [y]` when the two points have equal weight.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiClass_sub_coe (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ x y : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hxy : w x = w y) :
    (S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ x : S.ClassGroup) -
        (S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ y : S.ClassGroup) =
      S.divisorClass (pointDifference x y) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass
docstring: The additive Abel-Jacobi sum of a Weil divisor. For a divisor `D`, this is the class of `D - weightedDegree w D • [x₀]` in the abstract weighted-degree-zero Picard group. On point divisors it recovers `weightedAbelJacobiClass`, and on finite sums it is the corresponding sum of point Abel-Jacobi classes.
code:
noncomputable def weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) : WeilDivisor X →+ picZero w h :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_add
docstring: The Abel-Jacobi sum of a sum of divisors is the sum of their Abel-Jacobi sums.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_add (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (D E : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (D + E) =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D +
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ E :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_cast
docstring: Changing only the degree index of a fixed-degree divisor does not change its weighted Abel-Jacobi class.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_cast (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) {d e : ℕ} (hde : d = e)
    (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀
        (WeilDivisor.EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.cast hde D : WeilDivisor X) =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (D : WeilDivisor X) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_change_base
docstring: Changing the base point in the weighted Abel-Jacobi sum adds the weighted degree times the base-point-change class. Geometrically, for the residue-degree weight and rational base points `x₀`, `y₀`, this is the formal divisor-class identity `[D - deg(D)y₀] = [D - deg(D)x₀] + deg(D)[x₀ - y₀]` in `Pic⁰`.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_change_base (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ y₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hy₀ : w y₀ = 1)
    (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hy₀ D =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D +
        weightedDegree w D • S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w h (hx₀.trans hy₀.symm) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_effectiveDivisorOfDegree_add
docstring: Adding fixed-degree effective divisors sends their weighted Abel-Jacobi class to the sum of the two classes.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_effectiveDivisorOfDegree_add (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    (D : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) (E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X e) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.add D E) =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (D : WeilDivisor X) +
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (E : WeilDivisor X) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_effectiveDivisorOfDegree_zero
docstring: The weighted Abel-Jacobi class of the zero effective divisor is zero.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_effectiveDivisorOfDegree_zero (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.zero X) = 0 := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_iff_divisorClass
docstring: Equality of weighted Abel-Jacobi sums is equality of the corresponding degree-corrected divisor classes.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_iff_divisorClass
    (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D =
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ E ↔
      S.divisorClass (D - weightedDegree w D • ofPoint x₀) =
        S.divisorClass (E - weightedDegree w E • ofPoint x₀) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent
docstring: Equality of weighted Abel-Jacobi sums is linear equivalence of the corresponding degree-corrected divisors.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent
    (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D =
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ E ↔
      S.LinearlyEquivalent (D - weightedDegree w D • ofPoint x₀)
        (E - weightedDegree w E • ofPoint x₀) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent_of_weightedDegree_eq
docstring: If two divisors have the same weighted degree, equality of their weighted Abel-Jacobi classes is exactly linear equivalence of the original divisors. The equal-degree hypothesis is essential: the Abel-Jacobi class only records the `Pic⁰` component of the divisor class after subtracting the same degree from the chosen base point.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent_of_weightedDegree_eq
    (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} (hDE : weightedDegree w D = weightedDegree w E) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D =
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ E ↔
      S.LinearlyEquivalent D E := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_of_linearlyEquivalent
docstring: The Abel-Jacobi sum is invariant under linear equivalence of divisors with the same weighted degree.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_of_linearlyEquivalent
    (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} (hlin : S.LinearlyEquivalent D E) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ E := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_of_weightedDegree_eq_zero
docstring: If a divisor has weighted degree zero, its weighted Abel-Jacobi sum is independent of the choice of weight-one base point.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_of_weightedDegree_eq_zero (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ y₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hy₀ : w y₀ = 1)
    {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : weightedDegree w D = 0) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hy₀ D := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_sum
docstring: The Abel-Jacobi sum of a finitely supported formal divisor is the finite sum of the point Abel-Jacobi classes weighted by the divisor coefficients.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_sum (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D =
      D.sum fun x n => n • S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w h hx₀ x := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofFinset
docstring: The weighted Abel-Jacobi sum of a coefficient-one finite-set divisor is the sum of the point Abel-Jacobi classes over the finite set.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofFinset (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (s : Finset X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (ofFinset s) =
      ∑ x ∈ s, S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w h hx₀ x := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofFinsetWithMultiplicity
docstring: The weighted Abel-Jacobi sum of a finite-set divisor with multiplicities is the finite sum of the point Abel-Jacobi classes with those multiplicities.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofFinsetWithMultiplicity (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (s : Finset X)
    (m : X → ℕ) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (ofFinsetWithMultiplicity s m) =
      ∑ x ∈ s, (m x : ℤ) • S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w h hx₀ x := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofFinsupp
docstring: The weighted Abel-Jacobi sum of a divisor from finitely supported natural multiplicities is the finite sum of the point Abel-Jacobi classes with those multiplicities.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofFinsupp (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (m : X →₀ ℕ) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (ofFinsupp m) =
      ∑ x ∈ m.support, (m x : ℤ) • S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w h hx₀ x := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofPoint
docstring: On a point divisor, the Abel-Jacobi sum is the point Abel-Jacobi class.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofPoint (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (x : X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (ofPoint x) =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w h hx₀ x := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofPoint_base
docstring: The weighted Abel-Jacobi sum is zero on the base-point divisor.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofPoint_base (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (ofPoint x₀) = 0 := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofSym_append
docstring: Appending symmetric-power divisors sends their weighted Abel-Jacobi class to the sum of the two classes.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofSym_append (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (s : Sym X d) (t : Sym X e) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.ofSym (s.append t)) =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.ofSym s) +

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_one_effectiveDivisorOfDegree_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent
docstring: For effective divisors of the same fixed degree, equality of normalized Abel-Jacobi classes is exactly linear equivalence of the underlying divisors.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_one_effectiveDivisorOfDegree_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent
    (h : S.IsUnweightedDegreeZero) (x₀ : X)
    (D E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass (fun _ : X => (1 : ℤ)) h (x₀ := x₀) rfl
        (D : WeilDivisor X) =

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_one_effectiveDivisorOfDegree_eq_iff_mem_completeLinearSystem
docstring: The fixed-degree Abel-Jacobi fiber through `D` is the complete linear system `|D|`, restricted to effective divisors of the same degree.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_one_effectiveDivisorOfDegree_eq_iff_mem_completeLinearSystem
    (h : S.IsUnweightedDegreeZero) (x₀ : X)
    (D E : EffectiveDivisorOfDegree X d) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass (fun _ : X => (1 : ℤ)) h (x₀ := x₀) rfl
        (E : WeilDivisor X) =

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_one_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent_of_degree_eq
docstring: In the unweighted theory, equal-degree divisors have the same Abel-Jacobi class exactly when they are linearly equivalent.

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_one_ofSym_eq_iff_mem_completeLinearSystem
docstring: On symmetric powers, equality of normalized Abel-Jacobi classes is exactly membership of the corresponding divisor in the complete linear system.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_one_ofSym_eq_iff_mem_completeLinearSystem
    (h : S.IsUnweightedDegreeZero) (x₀ : X) (s t : Sym X d) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass (fun _ : X => (1 : ℤ)) h (x₀ := x₀) rfl
        (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.ofSym t : WeilDivisor X) =
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass (fun _ : X => (1 : ℤ)) h (x₀ := x₀) rfl
          (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.ofSym s : WeilDivisor X) ↔
      (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.ofSym t : WeilDivisor X) ∈
        S.completeLinearSystem (EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.ofSym s : WeilDivisor X) :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_principalDivisor
docstring: A principal divisor has zero Abel-Jacobi sum.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_principalDivisor (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (g : G) :

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_sub_change_base_coe
docstring: In the class group, the difference between weighted Abel-Jacobi divisor sums with two base points is the weighted degree times the class `[x₀] - [y₀]`.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_sub_change_base_coe (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ y₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hy₀ : w y₀ = 1)
    (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    (S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hy₀ D : S.ClassGroup) -
        (S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D : S.ClassGroup) =
      weightedDegree w D • S.divisorClass (pointDifference x₀ y₀) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_zsmul
docstring: The Abel-Jacobi sum of an integral multiple of a divisor is the corresponding multiple of the Abel-Jacobi sum.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_zsmul (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (n : ℤ) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (n • D) =
      n • S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass
docstring: The quotient class of the degree-corrected representative `D - weightedDegree(D) • [x₀]`.

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_add
docstring: The quotient Abel-Jacobi representative of a sum is the sum of the quotient representatives.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_add (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    (D E : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ (D + E) =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ D +
        S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ E :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_eq_iff_divisorClass
docstring: Equality of weighted quotient Abel-Jacobi representatives is equality of the corresponding degree-corrected divisor classes.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_eq_iff_divisorClass
    (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ D =
        S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ E ↔
      S.divisorClass (D - weightedDegree w D • ofPoint x₀) =
        S.divisorClass (E - weightedDegree w E • ofPoint x₀) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent
docstring: Equality of weighted quotient Abel-Jacobi representatives is linear equivalence of the corresponding degree-corrected divisors.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent
    (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ D =
        S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ E ↔
      S.LinearlyEquivalent (D - weightedDegree w D • ofPoint x₀)
        (E - weightedDegree w E • ofPoint x₀) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_eq_sum
docstring: The quotient Abel-Jacobi representative of a finitely supported formal divisor is the finite sum of the quotient representatives of its point divisors.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_eq_sum (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ D =
      D.sum fun x n => n • S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ (ofPoint x) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_mk
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_mk (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ D =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk (weightedAbelJacobiDegreeZeroDivisor w hx₀ D) :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_mk_def
code:
private lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_mk_def (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_ofPoint_base
docstring: The base-point divisor represents zero in the degree-zero quotient.
code:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_ofPoint_base (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) :

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_principalDivisor
docstring: A principal divisor has zero weighted quotient Abel-Jacobi representative.

docstring: The quotient Abel-Jacobi representative of an integral multiple is the corresponding multiple of the quotient representative.
code:

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedBasepointChangeClass
docstring: The degree-zero class `[x₀] - [y₀]` measuring the translation between two equal-weight base points.
code:
noncomputable def weightedBasepointChangeClass (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ y₀ : X} (hxy : w x₀ = w y₀) : picZero w hdeg :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedBasepointChangeClass_add
docstring: Base-point-change classes compose: the translation from `x₀` to `z₀` is the sum of the translations from `x₀` to `y₀` and from `y₀` to `z₀`.
code:
lemma weightedBasepointChangeClass_add (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ y₀ z₀ : X} (hxy : w x₀ = w y₀) (hyz : w y₀ = w z₀) :
    S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg hxy +
        S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg hyz =
      S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg (hxy.trans hyz) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedBasepointChangeClass_eq_abelJacobiClass
docstring: The base-point-change class equals the Abel-Jacobi class of the old base point with respect to the new base point.
code:
lemma weightedBasepointChangeClass_eq_abelJacobiClass (w : X → ℤ)
    (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ y₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hy₀ : w y₀ = 1) :
    S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg (hx₀.trans hy₀.symm) =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hy₀ x₀ := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedBasepointChangeClass_self
code:
lemma weightedBasepointChangeClass_self (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} :
    S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg (x₀ := x₀) rfl = 0 := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedBasepointChangeClass_swap
docstring: Reversing the two base points negates the base-point-change class.
code:
lemma weightedBasepointChangeClass_swap (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ y₀ : X} (hxy : w x₀ = w y₀) :
    S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg hxy.symm =
      -S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg hxy := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass

    S.ClassGroup →+ ℤ :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass_comp_degreeSection
docstring: With a weight-one base point, the degree section is a right inverse of the descended weighted degree: `weightedDegreeClass ∘ degreeSection = id`.
code:
lemma weightedDegreeClass_comp_degreeSection (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) :
    (weightedDegreeClass w h).comp (S.degreeSection x₀) = AddMonoidHom.id ℤ :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass_degreeSection
docstring: The descended weighted degree of the degree section at `n` is `n * w x₀`.
code:
lemma weightedDegreeClass_degreeSection (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    (x₀ : X) (n : ℤ) :
    weightedDegreeClass w h (S.degreeSection x₀ n) = n * w x₀ := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass_degreeSection_of_weight_one
code:
lemma weightedDegreeClass_degreeSection_of_weight_one (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (n : ℤ) :
    weightedDegreeClass w h (S.degreeSection x₀ n) = n := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass_divisorClass
code:
lemma weightedDegreeClass_divisorClass (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    weightedDegreeClass w h (S.divisorClass D) = weightedDegree w D :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass_divisorClass_ofPoint
docstring: The descended weighted degree of the base-point class is the weight of the base point.
code:
lemma weightedDegreeClass_divisorClass_ofPoint (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    (x₀ : X) : weightedDegreeClass w h (S.divisorClass (ofPoint x₀)) = w x₀ := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass_range
docstring: The image of the descended weighted degree on the class group is the same subgroup of `ℤ` generated by the weights. The class map `divisorClass` is surjective, so it does not change the image of the degree; the value is `weightedDegree_range` transported through the quotient.
code:
lemma weightedDegreeClass_range (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) :
    (weightedDegreeClass w h).range = AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range w) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass_range_eq_top
docstring: The descended weighted degree hits all of `ℤ` exactly when the weights generate `ℤ`, i.e. `AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range w) = ⊤`. This is the general surjectivity criterion; a weight-one base point is the special case `weightedDegreeClass_range_eq_top_of_weight_one`, but weights such as `2` and `3` already generate `ℤ` with no weight-one point.
code:
lemma weightedDegreeClass_range_eq_top (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    (hw : AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range w) = ⊤) : (weightedDegreeClass w h).range = ⊤ := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass_range_eq_top_of_weight_one
docstring: With a weight-one base point the descended weighted degree hits all of `ℤ`; this is the weight-one specialization of `weightedDegreeClass_range_eq_top`.
code:
lemma weightedDegreeClass_range_eq_top_of_weight_one (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) : (weightedDegreeClass w h).range = ⊤ := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass_surjective
docstring: With a weight-one base point, the descended weighted degree is surjective onto `ℤ`.
code:
lemma weightedDegreeClass_surjective (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) : Function.Surjective (weightedDegreeClass w h) :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom
docstring: The natural map from weighted-degree-zero divisors to the abstract degree-zero divisor class group `Pic⁰`, sending a divisor to its divisor class.
code:
def weightedDegreeZeroClassHom (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) :
    weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w →+ S.picZero w h where

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom_apply
code:
lemma weightedDegreeZeroClassHom_apply {w : X → ℤ} (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    (D : weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w) :
    S.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom w h D =

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom_eq_zero_iff
code:
lemma weightedDegreeZeroClassHom_eq_zero_iff {w : X → ℤ}
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {D : weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w} :
    S.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom w h D = 0 ↔
      (D : WeilDivisor X) ∈ S.principalSubgroup := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom_ker
docstring: The kernel of the map from weighted-degree-zero divisors to `Pic⁰` is exactly the subgroup of principal divisors inside the weighted-degree-zero divisor group.
code:
lemma weightedDegreeZeroClassHom_ker {w : X → ℤ} (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) :
    (S.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom w h).ker =
      S.principalSubgroupOfWeightedDegreeZero w := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom_surjective
docstring: The natural map from weighted-degree-zero divisors to `Pic⁰` is surjective: every degree-zero divisor class has a weighted-degree-zero representative.
code:
lemma weightedDegreeZeroClassHom_surjective {w : X → ℤ} (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) :
    Function.Surjective (S.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom w h) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero
docstring: The quotient of weighted-degree-zero divisors by principal divisors is the abstract degree-zero divisor class group `Pic⁰`.

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero_mk
code:
lemma weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero_mk {w : X → ℤ}
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) (D : weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w) :
    S.weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero w h
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk D) = S.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom w h D := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero_weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass
docstring: The quotient representative maps to the weighted Abel-Jacobi divisor class under the degree-zero quotient equivalence.
code:
lemma weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero_weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass
    (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero w h
        (S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ D) =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero_weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_ofPoint
docstring: For point divisors, the quotient representative maps to the point Abel-Jacobi class.
code:
lemma weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero_weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_ofPoint
    (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (x : X) :
    S.weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero w h
        (S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ (ofPoint x)) =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w h hx₀ x := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegree_eq_of_mem_completeLinearSystem
docstring: When principal divisors have weighted degree zero, every member of `|D|` has the same weighted degree as `D`.
code:
lemma weightedDegree_eq_of_mem_completeLinearSystem {w : X → ℤ} (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} (hE : E ∈ S.completeLinearSystem D) :
    weightedDegree w E = weightedDegree w D := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.zero_mem_principalKernel
code: lemma zero_mem_principalKernel : (0 : G) ∈ S.principalKernel := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.adicOrd
docstring: The order of vanishing `ord_v(f) = -log v(f)` of a nonzero rational function `f : Kˣ` at a height-one prime `v` of a Dedekind domain `R`, as a homomorphism `Additive Kˣ →+ ℤ`. It is the additive, sign-flipped form of Mathlib's multiplicative valuation `IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuationOfNeZero v : Kˣ →* Multiplicative ℤ`; the sign is chosen so that a uniformizer at `v` has order `+1` (a simple zero) and a pole has negative order.
code: noncomputable def adicOrd (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) : Additive Kˣ →+ ℤ :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.adicOrd_apply
docstring: The computational form of `adicOrd`: the order at `v` of an element `u : Additive Kˣ` is the sign-flipped logarithm `-log v(u)` of its `v`-adic valuation, where the underlying rational function is `(Additive.toMul u : Kˣ) : K`. The minus sign makes a uniformizer have order `+1`.
code:
lemma adicOrd_apply (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) (u : Additive Kˣ) :
    adicOrd R K v u = -WithZero.log (v.valuation K ((Additive.toMul u : Kˣ) : K)) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.adicOrd_eq_fractionalIdeal_count
docstring: The `v`-adic order of a rational function agrees with Mathlib's exponent of the corresponding principal fractional ideal.
code:
lemma adicOrd_eq_fractionalIdeal_count (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) (u : Additive Kˣ) :
    adicOrd R K v u =
      FractionalIdeal.count K v
        (toPrincipalIdeal R K (Additive.toMul u) : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.adicOrd_ne_zero_mem_support_union
docstring: A nonzero `v`-adic order means that `v` lies in the support of the function or of its inverse. This is the implementation helper that drives the finiteness proof of `OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain`.
code:
private lemma adicOrd_ne_zero_mem_support_union (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) (u : Additive Kˣ)
    (h : adicOrd R K v u ≠ 0) :
    v ∈ HeightOneSpectrum.Support R ((Additive.toMul u : Kˣ) : K) ∪
      HeightOneSpectrum.Support R (((Additive.toMul u : Kˣ) : K)⁻¹) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.adicOrd_nonneg_iff
docstring: The order `ord_v(f)` is nonnegative exactly when `f` is integral at `v`, i.e. has valuation at most one.
code:
lemma adicOrd_nonneg_iff (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) (u : Additive Kˣ) :
    0 ≤ adicOrd R K v u ↔ v.valuation K ((Additive.toMul u : Kˣ) : K) ≤ 1 := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.adicOrd_ofMul
docstring: The computational form of `adicOrd` applied to `Additive.ofMul u` for a multiplicative unit `u : Kˣ`: it is the sign-flipped logarithm `-log v(u)` of the `v`-adic valuation of `u : K`.
code:
lemma adicOrd_ofMul (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) (u : Kˣ) :
    adicOrd R K v (Additive.ofMul u) = -WithZero.log (v.valuation K (u : K)) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.classGroupAddEquiv
docstring: **The divisor class group of the affine Dedekind curve is the ideal class group.** For a Dedekind domain `R` with fraction field `K`, the Weil-divisor divisor class group `(OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).ClassGroup` of the height-one spectrum is isomorphic to the ideal class group `ClassGroup R`, via the isomorphism `fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv R K` of invertible fractional ideals with Weil divisors descended to the quotient by principal divisors/ideals. This is the affine `Cl(X) ≅ Pic X` of the Jacobian roadmap. See `classGroupAddEquiv_divisorClass_fractionalIdealDivisor` and `classGroupAddEquiv_symm_ofMul_mk` for the characterizing formulas.
code:
noncomputable def classGroupAddEquiv :
    (OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).ClassGroup ≃+ Additive (ClassGroup R) :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.classGroupAddEquiv_divisorClass
docstring: The class group isomorphism on a general divisor class: the class of a Weil divisor `D` maps to the ideal class of the invertible fractional ideal `∏_v v ^ (D v)` recovered from `D`.
code:
lemma classGroupAddEquiv_divisorClass (D : WeilDivisor (HeightOneSpectrum R)) :
    classGroupAddEquiv R K ((OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).divisorClass D) =
      Additive.ofMul (ClassGroup.mk K (Additive.toMul
        ((fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv R K).symm D))) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.classGroupAddEquiv_divisorClass_fractionalIdealDivisor
docstring: The class group isomorphism sends the class of the Weil divisor of an invertible fractional ideal `I` to the ideal class of `I`. Together with the surjectivity of `fractionalIdealDivisor` and of `divisorClass` this pins down `classGroupAddEquiv` on every element.
code:
lemma classGroupAddEquiv_divisorClass_fractionalIdealDivisor (I : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) :
    classGroupAddEquiv R K
        ((OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).divisorClass
          (fractionalIdealDivisor R K (Additive.ofMul I)))
      = Additive.ofMul (ClassGroup.mk K I) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.classGroupAddEquiv_divisorClass_ofPoint
docstring: Non-vacuity: the class group isomorphism sends the class of the point divisor `[v]` of a height-one prime `v` to the ideal class of `v`, viewed as an invertible fractional ideal.
code:
lemma classGroupAddEquiv_divisorClass_ofPoint (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    classGroupAddEquiv R K ((OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).divisorClass (ofPoint v)) =
      Additive.ofMul (ClassGroup.mk K
        (Units.mk0 (v.asIdeal : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)
          (FractionalIdeal.coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr v.ne_bot))) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.classGroupAddEquiv_symm_ofMul_mk
docstring: The inverse of the class group isomorphism sends the ideal class of an invertible fractional ideal `I` to the divisor class of the Weil divisor of `I`. This is the canonical inverse formula, dual to `classGroupAddEquiv_divisorClass_fractionalIdealDivisor`.
code:
lemma classGroupAddEquiv_symm_ofMul_mk (I : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) :
    (classGroupAddEquiv R K).symm (Additive.ofMul (ClassGroup.mk K I)) =
      (OrderSystem.ofDedekindDomain R K).divisorClass
        (fractionalIdealDivisor R K (Additive.ofMul I)) :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.coe_weightedAbelJacobiDegreeZeroDivisor_def

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdealDivisor
docstring: The **Weil divisor of an invertible fractional ideal**: the formal sum `Σ_v count K v I · [v]` of the `v`-adic multiplicities of `I` over the height-one primes `v` of `R`, as a homomorphism from the group of invertible fractional ideals to the free Weil-divisor group. The multiplicity is zero for all but finitely many `v` (`FractionalIdeal.finite_factors`), and the multiplicativity of `FractionalIdeal.count` makes this additive.
code:
noncomputable def fractionalIdealDivisor :
    Additive (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ →+ WeilDivisor (HeightOneSpectrum R) where

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv
docstring: **The Weil ≃ Cartier dictionary for the affine Dedekind chart.** The group of invertible fractional ideals of a Dedekind domain `R` is isomorphic to the free Weil-divisor group on the height-one primes of `R`, by taking `v`-adic multiplicities. The inverse sends a divisor `D` to the fractional ideal `∏_v v^(D v)`.
code:
noncomputable def fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv :
    Additive (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ ≃+ WeilDivisor (HeightOneSpectrum R) :=

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_apply
docstring: On forward application the packaged equivalence `fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv` agrees with the underlying homomorphism `fractionalIdealDivisor`.
code:
lemma fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_apply (I : Additive (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) :
    fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv R K I = fractionalIdealDivisor R K I := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_symm_apply
docstring: The inverse of `fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv` sends a Weil divisor `D` to the invertible fractional ideal `∏_v v^(D v)`: the product of the prime ideals `v.asIdeal` raised to the multiplicities `D v`. This gives the canonical formula for the inverse, which `AddEquiv.ofBijective` otherwise leaves as an unspecified choice inverse.
code:
lemma fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_symm_apply (D : WeilDivisor (HeightOneSpectrum R)) :
    (fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv R K).symm D =
      Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 (D.prod fun v e => (v.asIdeal : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) ^ e)
        (prod_asIdeal_zpow_ne_zero R K D)) := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_toPrincipalIdeal

    fractionalIdealDivisor R K
        (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 (v.asIdeal : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)
          (FractionalIdeal.coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr v.ne_bot))) = ofPoint v := by

label: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.fractionalIdealDivisor_injective

label: TauCeti.Circle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv
docstring: The fundamental group of the complex unit circle `Circle = {z : ℂ | ‖z‖ = 1}`, based at `1`, is `Multiplicative ℤ`: `π₁(S¹) ≅ ℤ`. It is obtained by transporting the additive-circle computation `TauCeti.AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero` across the homeomorphism `AddCircle.homeomorphCircle : AddCircle (2 * π) ≃ₜ Circle`, which carries the basepoint `0` to `1`.
code: def fundamentalGroupMulEquiv : FundamentalGroup Circle 1 ≃* Multiplicative ℤ :=

label: TauCeti.Circle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_def
docstring: `fundamentalGroupMulEquiv` factors as the homeomorphism-invariance isomorphism of `AddCircle.homeomorphCircle.symm` (based at `1 ↦ 0`) composed with the additive-circle computation `AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero`. This exposes the otherwise-opaque definition, so a downstream consumer can rewrite a loop's image in `Multiplicative ℤ` through the component `@[simp]` lemmas `FundamentalGroup.homeomorphMulEquivOfEq_apply` and the `AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero` characterization.
code:
theorem fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_def :
    fundamentalGroupMulEquiv =
      (FundamentalGroup.homeomorphMulEquivOfEq
          (AddCircle.homeomorphCircle (T := 2 * Real.pi) Real.two_pi_pos.ne').symm
          homeomorphCircle_symm_one).trans
        (AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero (2 * Real.pi) Real.two_pi_pos.ne') := by

label: TauCeti.Circle.homeomorphCircle_symm_one
docstring: The homeomorphism `AddCircle.homeomorphCircle : AddCircle (2 * π) ≃ₜ Circle` carries the basepoint `0` to `1`, so its inverse carries `1` back to `0`. This is the basepoint hypothesis that transports the additive-circle computation to `Circle`.
code:
theorem homeomorphCircle_symm_one :
    (AddCircle.homeomorphCircle (T := 2 * Real.pi) Real.two_pi_pos.ne').symm 1 = 0 := by

label: TauCeti.ClassGroup.elementaryTwoQuotientCongr
docstring: A multiplicative equivalence of class groups induces a `ZMod 2`-linear equivalence on the maximal elementary-2 quotients. This is the transport API used when genus-field constructions identify class groups through canonical isomorphisms.
code:
noncomputable def elementaryTwoQuotientCongr {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsDomain S]
    (e : ClassGroup R ≃* ClassGroup S) :
    ElementaryTwoQuotient R ≃ₗ[ZMod 2] ElementaryTwoQuotient S :=

label: TauCeti.ClassGroup.elementaryTwoQuotientCongr_mk
docstring: The induced equivalence on `Cl/Cl²` sends the class of an ideal class to the class of its image.
code:
@[simp] theorem elementaryTwoQuotientCongr_mk {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsDomain S]
    (e : ClassGroup R ≃* ClassGroup S) (C : ClassGroup R) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientCongr e (elementaryTwoQuotientMk R C) =
      elementaryTwoQuotientMk S (e C) := by

label: TauCeti.ClassGroup.elementaryTwoQuotientCongr_refl_apply
docstring: The identity equivalence of class groups induces the identity equivalence on `Cl/Cl²`.
code:
@[simp] theorem elementaryTwoQuotientCongr_refl_apply (x : ElementaryTwoQuotient R) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientCongr (MulEquiv.refl (ClassGroup R)) x = x :=

label: TauCeti.ClassGroup.elementaryTwoQuotientCongr_symm_mk
docstring: The inverse induced equivalence on `Cl/Cl²` sends the class of an ideal class to the class of its inverse image.
code:
@[simp] theorem elementaryTwoQuotientCongr_symm_mk {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsDomain S]
    (e : ClassGroup R ≃* ClassGroup S) (C : ClassGroup S) :
    (elementaryTwoQuotientCongr e).symm (elementaryTwoQuotientMk S C) =
      elementaryTwoQuotientMk R (e.symm C) := by

label: TauCeti.ClassGroup.elementaryTwoQuotientCongr_trans_apply
docstring: Induced class-group equivalences on `Cl/Cl²` compose functorially.
code:
@[simp] theorem elementaryTwoQuotientCongr_trans_apply {S T : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsDomain S]
    [CommRing T] [IsDomain T] (e : ClassGroup R ≃* ClassGroup S)
    (e' : ClassGroup S ≃* ClassGroup T) (x : ElementaryTwoQuotient R) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientCongr (e.trans e') x =
      elementaryTwoQuotientCongr e' (elementaryTwoQuotientCongr e x) :=

label: TauCeti.ClassGroup.elementaryTwoQuotientMk

label: TauCeti.ClassGroup.elementaryTwoQuotientMk_div

code:

    elementaryTwoQuotientMk R (C / D) =

label: TauCeti.ClassGroup.elementaryTwoQuotientMk_eq_iff
docstring: Two ideal classes have the same class in `Cl(R)/Cl(R)²` iff they differ by a square.

theorem elementaryTwoQuotientMk_eq_iff (C D : ClassGroup R) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientMk R C = elementaryTwoQuotientMk R D ↔ IsSquare (C / D) :=

label: TauCeti.ClassGroup.elementaryTwoQuotientMk_eq_zero_iff
docstring: An ideal class has trivial class in `Cl(R)/Cl(R)²` iff it is a square.
code:
@[simp] theorem elementaryTwoQuotientMk_eq_zero_iff (C : ClassGroup R) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientMk R C = 0 ↔ IsSquare C :=

label: TauCeti.ClassGroup.elementaryTwoQuotientMk_inv
docstring: The class map to `Cl(R)/Cl(R)²` sends inverses to negatives.
code:
@[simp] theorem elementaryTwoQuotientMk_inv (C : ClassGroup R) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientMk R C⁻¹ = -elementaryTwoQuotientMk R C :=

label: TauCeti.ClassGroup.elementaryTwoQuotientMk_mul
docstring: The class map to `Cl(R)/Cl(R)²` sends a product of ideal classes to the sum of the classes.
code:
@[simp] theorem elementaryTwoQuotientMk_mul (C D : ClassGroup R) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientMk R (C * D) = elementaryTwoQuotientMk R C + elementaryTwoQuotientMk R D :=

label: TauCeti.ClassGroup.elementaryTwoQuotientMk_one
docstring: The class map to `Cl(R)/Cl(R)²` sends the trivial ideal class to `0`.

    elementaryTwoQuotientMk R (1 : ClassGroup R) = 0 :=

label: TauCeti.ClassGroup.elementaryTwoQuotientMk_pow

code:
@[simp] theorem elementaryTwoQuotientMk_pow (C : ClassGroup R) (n : ℕ) :
    elementaryTwoQuotientMk R (C ^ n) = n • elementaryTwoQuotientMk R C :=

label: TauCeti.ClassGroup.elementaryTwoQuotientMk_prod
docstring: The class map to `Cl(R)/Cl(R)²` sends a finite product of ideal classes to the sum of the classes.

    elementaryTwoQuotientMk R (∏ i ∈ S, C i) = ∑ i ∈ S, elementaryTwoQuotientMk R (C i) :=

docstring: The underlying algebra hom of a restricted categorical morphism is restriction of scalars on the original algebra hom.

lemma restrictScalarsMap_hom {A B : _root_.CommAlgCat.{x} K}
    (f : k →+* K) (χ : A ⟶ B) :
    (restrictScalarsMap f χ).hom =
      letI : Algebra k K := f.toAlgebra
      letI : Algebra k A := Algebra.compHom A f
      letI : IsScalarTower k K A := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
      letI : Algebra k B := Algebra.compHom B f
      letI : IsScalarTower k K B := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
      χ.hom.restrictScalars k :=

    baseChangePointsMulEquiv (K := K) A H
        (AlgHom.mapDomain (A := A) ((baseChangeMap (K := K) φ).hom) f) =
      AlgHom.mapDomain
        (A := _root_.TauCeti.CommAlgCat.restrictScalarsObj (algebraMap k K) A)
        φ.hom
        (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (K := K) A L f) := by

docstring: The base-change points equivalence is natural in the value algebra.
code:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapValue
    {B : CommAlgCat.{x} K} (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} k)
    (χ : A ⟶ B) (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := K) (H := baseChange (K := K) H) A) :
    baseChangePointsMulEquiv (K := K) B H (HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := baseChange (K := K) H) χ f) =
      HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := H)
        ((_root_.TauCeti.CommAlgCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap k K)).map χ)

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapPointsFunctor
docstring: A morphism of coordinate commutative Hopf algebras induces a natural transformation between their group-valued points functors, contravariantly in the coordinate algebra. At a commutative `R`-algebra `A`, this sends an `A`-valued point `f : K →ₐ[R] A` to `f ∘ φ : H →ₐ[R] A`.

@[expose] noncomputable def mapPointsFunctor {H K : CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R} (φ : H ⟶ K) :
    HopfAlgebra.pointsFunctor (R := R) (H := K) ⟶
      HopfAlgebra.pointsFunctor (R := R) (H := H) where

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapPointsFunctor_app_apply
docstring: On points, `mapPointsFunctor φ` is pre-composition with `φ`.
code:
lemma mapPointsFunctor_app_apply {H K : CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R} (φ : H ⟶ K)

    (mapPointsFunctor φ).app A f =
      toConv (f.ofConv.comp (φ.hom : H →ₐ[R] K)) := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapPointsFunctor_app_apply_apply
docstring: Pointwise form of `mapPointsFunctor_app_apply`.

lemma mapPointsFunctor_app_apply_apply {H K : CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R} (φ : H ⟶ K)

    (((mapPointsFunctor φ).app A f).ofConv) h = f.ofConv (φ.hom h) := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapPointsFunctor_app_injective_of_surjective
docstring: Pre-composition with a surjective coordinate morphism is injective on points.

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapPointsFunctor_comp
docstring: `mapPointsFunctor` sends coordinate-algebra composition to reverse composition of natural transformations.
code:
lemma mapPointsFunctor_comp {H K L : CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R} (φ : H ⟶ K) (ψ : K ⟶ L) :
    mapPointsFunctor (φ ≫ ψ) =
      mapPointsFunctor ψ ≫ mapPointsFunctor φ := by

docstring: `mapPointsFunctor` sends the identity coordinate morphism to the identity natural transformation.

    mapPointsFunctor (𝟙 H) =
      𝟙 (HopfAlgebra.pointsFunctor (R := R) (H := H) :
        CommAlgCat.{w} R ⥤ GrpCat.{max v w}) := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapPointsFunctor_naturality_apply
docstring: Naturality of the point map induced by a coordinate morphism, applied to a point.
code:
lemma mapPointsFunctor_naturality_apply {H K : CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R} (φ : H ⟶ K)
    {A B : CommAlgCat.{w} R} (χ : A ⟶ B)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := K) A) :
    HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := H) χ ((mapPointsFunctor φ).app A f) =
      (mapPointsFunctor φ).app B (HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := K) χ f) := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapPoints_liftQuotientPoint
docstring: Factoring an ambient point through the quotient is natural in the value algebra.
code:
lemma mapPoints_liftQuotientPoint (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) {A B : CommAlgCat.{w} R}
    (χ : A ⟶ B) (g : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H) A)
    (hg : ∀ h : H, h ∈ I → g.ofConv h = 0) :
    HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := quotient H I) χ
        (liftQuotientPoint H I A g hg) =
      liftQuotientPoint H I B (HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := H) χ g)
        (by
          intro h hh
          exact (mem_quotientPointsSubgroup_iff H I B _).mp
            (mapPoints_mem_quotientPointsSubgroup H I χ
              ((mem_quotientPointsSubgroup_iff H I A g).mpr hg)) h hh) := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapPoints_mem_quotientPointsSubgroup
docstring: Post-composition preserves the ambient-point subgroup cut out by a Hopf ideal.

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapPoints_quotientPointsHom
docstring: The quotient-points inclusion is natural in the value algebra.
code:
lemma mapPoints_quotientPointsHom (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) {A B : CommAlgCat.{w} R}
    (χ : A ⟶ B) (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H I) A) :
    HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := H) χ (quotientPointsHom H I A f) =
      quotientPointsHom H I B (HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := quotient H I) χ f) := by

@[expose] noncomputable def mapQuotientPointsSubgroup (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_apply

code:
lemma mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_apply (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)

    (χ : A ⟶ B) (g : quotientPointsSubgroup H I A) :

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_apply_apply
docstring: Pointwise form of the restricted subgroup map.

lemma mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_apply_apply (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) {A B : CommAlgCat.{w} R}

    ((mapQuotientPointsSubgroup H I χ g :

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_comp

lemma mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_comp (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)

    mapQuotientPointsSubgroup H I (𝟙 A) =

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_inclusion_apply
docstring: The subgroup inclusions associated to `I ≤ J` commute with maps of value algebras.
code:
theorem mapQuotientPointsSubgroup_inclusion_apply
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    {A B : CommAlgCat.{w} R} (χ : A ⟶ B) (g : quotientPointsSubgroup H J A) :
    mapQuotientPointsSubgroup H I χ
        (Subgroup.inclusion (quotientPointsSubgroup_le_of_le H hIJ A) g) =
      Subgroup.inclusion (quotientPointsSubgroup_le_of_le H hIJ B)
        (mapQuotientPointsSubgroup H J χ g) := by

    {g : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H) A}

A morphism `φ : H ⟶ K` is sent contravariantly to the natural transformation that pre-composes `K`-points by `φ`.

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe
docstring: The coordinate morphism `H ⧸ I ⟶ H ⧸ J` induced by an inclusion `I ≤ J` of Hopf ideals. It is the unique morphism out of `H ⧸ I` whose composite with `H ⟶ H ⧸ I` is the quotient map `H ⟶ H ⧸ J`.
code:
noncomputable abbrev quotientMapOfLe (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) : quotient H I ⟶ quotient H J :=

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe_comp
docstring: Quotient-to-quotient morphisms compose along inclusions of Hopf ideals.
code:
lemma quotientMapOfLe_comp (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    {I J K : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) (hJK : J ≤ K) :
    quotientMapOfLe H hIJ ≫ quotientMapOfLe H hJK =
      quotientMapOfLe H (hIJ.trans hJK) := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe_mk
docstring: The quotient-to-quotient morphism sends the class of `h` modulo `I` to its class modulo `J`.
code:
lemma quotientMapOfLe_mk (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) {I J : HopfIdeal R H}
    (hIJ : I ≤ J) (h : H) :
    (quotientMapOfLe H hIJ).hom (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R J.toIdeal h := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe_refl
docstring: The quotient-to-quotient morphism for `I ≤ I` is the identity morphism.
code:
lemma quotientMapOfLe_refl (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    quotientMapOfLe H (le_refl I) = 𝟙 (quotient H I) := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom
docstring: The map on `A`-points induced by the quotient coordinate morphism `H ⟶ H ⧸ I`. Contravariantly, this is the closed-subgroup inclusion on points: it sends a point of the quotient Hopf algebra to its composite with the quotient map from `H`.
code:
@[expose] noncomputable def quotientPointsHom (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) :
    HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H I) A ⟶
      HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H) A :=

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom_apply
docstring: The quotient-points map acts by pre-composition with the quotient morphism.
code:
lemma quotientPointsHom_apply (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H)
    (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H I) A) :
    quotientPointsHom H I A f =
      toConv (f.ofConv.comp ((mkQuotient H I).hom : H →ₐ[R] quotient H I)) :=

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom_apply_apply
docstring: Pointwise form of `CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom_apply`.
code:
lemma quotientPointsHom_apply_apply (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H I) A) (h : H) :
    ((quotientPointsHom H I A f).ofConv) h =
      f.ofConv (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h) := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom_injective
docstring: The map from quotient points to ambient points is injective.
code:
lemma quotientPointsHom_injective (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) :
    Function.Injective (quotientPointsHom H I A) :=

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom_liftQuotientPoint
docstring: Factoring a point that kills `I` through the quotient and then including it back in the ambient point group recovers the original point.
code:
lemma quotientPointsHom_liftQuotientPoint (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (g : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H) A)
    (hg : ∀ h : H, h ∈ I → g.ofConv h = 0) :
    quotientPointsHom H I A (liftQuotientPoint H I A g hg) = g := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom_mapPointsFunctor_quotientMapOfLe_app
docstring: On points, precomposition with `quotientMapOfLe` is compatible with the ambient quotient-points inclusions. Starting with a point of `H ⧸ J`, mapping it to a point of `H ⧸ I` and then including into ambient `H`-points gives the same ambient point as the direct inclusion from `H ⧸ J`.
code:
lemma quotientPointsHom_mapPointsFunctor_quotientMapOfLe_app
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H J) A) :
    quotientPointsHom H I A ((mapPointsFunctor (quotientMapOfLe H hIJ)).app A f) =
      quotientPointsHom H J A f := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom_mapPointsFunctor_quotientMapOfLe_app_apply
docstring: The pointwise form of `CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom_mapPointsFunctor_quotientMapOfLe_app`.
code:
lemma quotientPointsHom_mapPointsFunctor_quotientMapOfLe_app_apply
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H J) A) (h : H) :
    (quotientPointsHom H I A ((mapPointsFunctor (quotientMapOfLe H hIJ)).app A f)).ofConv h =
      f.ofConv (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R J.toIdeal h) := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsHom_mem_quotientPointsSubgroup
docstring: The included quotient point belongs to the subgroup cut out by the Hopf ideal.
code:
lemma quotientPointsHom_mem_quotientPointsSubgroup (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H I) A) :
    quotientPointsHom H I A f ∈ quotientPointsSubgroup H I A :=

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroup
docstring: The subgroup of ambient `A`-points cut out by a Hopf ideal `I`. Its elements are exactly those algebra maps `H →ₐ[R] A` that vanish on `I`; this is the point-level closed subgroup represented by the quotient coordinate Hopf algebra `H ⧸ I`.
code:
@[expose] noncomputable def quotientPointsSubgroup (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) :
    Subgroup (HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H) A) :=

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor
docstring: The value-algebra functor of the point subgroups cut out by a Hopf ideal.
code:
@[expose] noncomputable def quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    CommAlgCat.{w} R ⥤ GrpCat.{max v w} where

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor_map
docstring: The map part of the subgroup functor is the restricted value-algebra map.
code:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor_map (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) {A B : CommAlgCat.{w} R} (χ : A ⟶ B) :
    (quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor (R := R) H I).map χ =
      GrpCat.ofHom (mapQuotientPointsSubgroup H I χ) :=

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor_map_quotientPointsHom
docstring: The image of a quotient point under the subgroup functor is its mapped quotient point, viewed inside the cut-out subgroup.
code:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor_map_quotientPointsHom
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) {A B : CommAlgCat.{w} R}
    (χ : A ⟶ B) (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H I) A) :
    mapQuotientPointsSubgroup H I χ
        ⟨quotientPointsHom H I A f, quotientPointsHom_mem_quotientPointsSubgroup H I A f⟩ =
      ⟨quotientPointsHom H I B (HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := quotient H I) χ f),
        quotientPointsHom_mem_quotientPointsSubgroup H I B _⟩ := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor_map_quotientPointsHom_aux
code:
private lemma quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor_map_quotientPointsHom_aux
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) {A B : CommAlgCat.{w} R}
    (χ : A ⟶ B) (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H I) A) :
    mapQuotientPointsSubgroup H I χ
        ⟨quotientPointsHom H I A f, quotientPointsHom_mem_quotientPointsSubgroup H I A f⟩ =
      ⟨quotientPointsHom H I B (HopfAlgebra.mapPoints (H := quotient H I) χ f),
        quotientPointsHom_mem_quotientPointsSubgroup H I B _⟩ := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor_obj
docstring: The object part of the subgroup functor is the cut-out point subgroup.
code:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor_obj (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) :
    (quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor (R := R) H I).obj A =
      GrpCat.of (quotientPointsSubgroup H I A) :=

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupIncl
docstring: The subgroup functor includes naturally into the ambient functor of points.
code:
@[expose] noncomputable def quotientPointsSubgroupIncl (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor (R := R) H I ⟶
      HopfAlgebra.pointsFunctor (R := R) (H := H) where

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupIncl_app
docstring: The component of the subgroup inclusion is the subgroup subtype map.
code:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupIncl_app (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) :
    (quotientPointsSubgroupIncl H I).app A =
      GrpCat.ofHom (quotientPointsSubgroup H I A).subtype :=

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion
docstring: The natural inclusion of subgroup functors associated to `I ≤ J`.
code:
@[expose] noncomputable def quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor (R := R) H J ⟶
      quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor (R := R) H I where

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion_app
docstring: The component of `quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion` is the subgroup inclusion.
code:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion_app
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) :
    (quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion (R := R) H hIJ).app A =
      GrpCat.ofHom (Subgroup.inclusion (quotientPointsSubgroup_le_of_le H hIJ A)) :=

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion_comp
docstring: Inclusions of quotient point subgroup functors compose along transitive ideal inclusions.
code:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion_comp
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) {I J K : HopfIdeal R H}
    (hIJ : I ≤ J) (hJK : J ≤ K) :
    quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion (R := R) H hJK ≫
        quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion (R := R) H hIJ =
      quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion (R := R) H (hIJ.trans hJK) := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion_refl
docstring: The inclusion associated to reflexivity is the identity natural transformation.
code:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion_refl
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    quotientPointsSubgroupInclusion (R := R) H (le_refl I) =
      𝟙 (quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor (R := R) H I) := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupIso
docstring: The component isomorphism between quotient points and the cut-out subgroup.
code:
@[expose] noncomputable def quotientPointsSubgroupIso (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) :
    GrpCat.of (HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H I) A) ≅
      GrpCat.of (quotientPointsSubgroup H I A) :=

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupIso_hom_apply
docstring: The component isomorphism sends a quotient point to its included ambient point.
code:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupIso_hom_apply (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H I) A) :
    (quotientPointsSubgroupIso H I A).hom f =
      (⟨quotientPointsHom H I A f, quotientPointsHom_mem_quotientPointsSubgroup H I A f⟩ :
        quotientPointsSubgroup H I A) :=

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupIso_hom_mapPointsFunctor_quotientMapOfLe_app
docstring: Under the quotient-point subgroup isomorphisms, the points map induced by `quotientMapOfLe` is exactly the subgroup inclusion attached to `I ≤ J`.
code:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupIso_hom_mapPointsFunctor_quotientMapOfLe_app
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H J) A) :
    (quotientPointsSubgroupIso H I A).hom
        ((mapPointsFunctor (quotientMapOfLe H hIJ)).app A f) =
      Subgroup.inclusion (quotientPointsSubgroup_le_of_le H hIJ A)
        ((quotientPointsSubgroupIso H J A).hom f) := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupIso_inv_apply
docstring: The inverse component is the quotient point factoring the included ambient point.
code:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupIso_inv_apply (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (g : quotientPointsSubgroup H I A) :
    (quotientPointsSubgroupIso H I A).inv g =
      liftQuotientPoint H I A g ((mem_quotientPointsSubgroup_iff H I A g).mp g.property) := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupNatIso
docstring: The quotient Hopf algebra represents the subgroup functor cut out by the Hopf ideal.
code:
noncomputable def quotientPointsSubgroupNatIso (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    HopfAlgebra.pointsFunctor (R := R) (H := quotient H I) ≅
      quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor (R := R) H I :=

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupNatIso_hom_app_apply
docstring: The natural isomorphism's forward component is the quotient-subgroup component isomorphism.
code:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupNatIso_hom_app_apply (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := quotient H I) A) :
    CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom
        (X := HopfAlgebra.pointsFunctor (R := R) (H := quotient H I).obj A)
        (Y := GrpCat.of (quotientPointsSubgroup H I A))
        ((quotientPointsSubgroupNatIso H I).hom.app A) f =
      (⟨quotientPointsHom H I A f, quotientPointsHom_mem_quotientPointsSubgroup H I A f⟩ :
        quotientPointsSubgroup H I A) := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroupNatIso_inv_app_apply
docstring: The natural isomorphism's inverse component is the quotient lift of a subgroup point.
code:
lemma quotientPointsSubgroupNatIso_inv_app_apply (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (g : quotientPointsSubgroup H I A) :
    CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom
        (X := GrpCat.of (quotientPointsSubgroup H I A))
        (Y := HopfAlgebra.pointsFunctor (R := R) (H := quotient H I).obj A)
        ((quotientPointsSubgroupNatIso H I).inv.app A) g =
      liftQuotientPoint H I A g ((mem_quotientPointsSubgroup_iff H I A g).mp g.property) := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroup_antitone
docstring: The point subgroup cut out by a Hopf ideal is antitone in the Hopf ideal: larger ideals impose more vanishing equations.
code:
theorem quotientPointsSubgroup_antitone (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) :
    Antitone fun I : HopfIdeal R H => quotientPointsSubgroup H I A := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroup_bot
docstring: The point subgroup cut out by the zero Hopf ideal is the full ambient point group.
code:
theorem quotientPointsSubgroup_bot (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) :
    quotientPointsSubgroup H (⊥ : HopfIdeal R H) A = ⊤ := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroup_eq_of_eq
docstring: If `I = J`, then the point subgroups cut out by `I` and `J` are equal.
code:
theorem quotientPointsSubgroup_eq_of_eq (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I = J) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) :
    quotientPointsSubgroup H I A = quotientPointsSubgroup H J A := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientPointsSubgroup_le_of_le
docstring: If `I ≤ J`, then the point subgroup cut out by `J` is contained in the point subgroup cut out by `I`.
code:
theorem quotientPointsSubgroup_le_of_le (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) :
    quotientPointsSubgroup H J A ≤ quotientPointsSubgroup H I A :=

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom
docstring: Deprecated: use `φ.hom`. Turn a morphism in `CommHopfAlgCat` back into a bialgebra morphism; this is Mathlib's `CommHopfAlgCat.Hom.hom`.
code: abbrev toBialgHom {H K : CommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R} (φ : H ⟶ K) : H →ₐc[R] K :=

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom_comp
docstring: Deprecated: `toBialgHom (φ ≫ ψ) = (toBialgHom ψ).comp (toBialgHom φ)`; use `CommHopfAlgCat.hom_comp`.
code:
lemma toBialgHom_comp {H K L : CommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R} (φ : H ⟶ K) (ψ : K ⟶ L) :
    toBialgHom (φ ≫ ψ) = (toBialgHom ψ).comp (toBialgHom φ) :=

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom_id
docstring: Deprecated: `toBialgHom (𝟙 H) = BialgHom.id R H`; use `CommHopfAlgCat.hom_id`.
code:
lemma toBialgHom_id {H : CommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R} :
    toBialgHom (𝟙 H : H ⟶ H) = BialgHom.id R H := by

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom_ofHom
docstring: Deprecated: `toBialgHom (ofHom φ) = φ`; use `CommHopfAlgCat.hom_ofHom`.
code:
lemma toBialgHom_ofHom {H K : Type v} [CommRing H] [CommRing K]
    [_root_.HopfAlgebra R H] [_root_.HopfAlgebra R K] (φ : H →ₐc[R] K) :
    toBialgHom (_root_.CommHopfAlgCat.ofHom (R := R) φ) = φ :=

label: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.toIdeal_le_ker_mkQuotient_of_le
docstring: If `I ≤ J`, then the quotient map by `J` kills every element of `I`.
code:
lemma toIdeal_le_ker_mkQuotient_of_le
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker (mkQuotient H J).hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom := by

label: TauCeti.Comodule
docstring: A right comodule over an `R`-coalgebra `C`. The coaction is written as a linear map `coact : M →ₗ[R] M ⊗[R] C`. The coassociativity law says that coacting twice on the `M` component agrees with coacting once and then comultiplying the `C` component. The counit law says that applying the coalgebra counit to the `C` component recovers the original vector, under the canonical `M ⊗ R` presentation.
code:
class Comodule (R : Type u) (C : Type v) (M : Type w) [CommSemiring R]
    [AddCommMonoid C] [Module R C] [Coalgebra R C] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] where

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Corestrict
docstring: Corestrict a right comodule along a coalgebra morphism. If `M` is a right `C`-comodule and `f : C →ₗc[R] D`, the new right `D`-coaction is `(id ⊗ f) ∘ ρ`.
code: def Corestrict (f : C →ₗc[R] D) : Comodule R D M where

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom
docstring: A morphism of right comodules over a fixed coalgebra.
code:
structure Hom (R : Type u) (C : Type v) (M : Type w) (N : Type x) [CommSemiring R]
    [AddCommMonoid C] [Module R C] [Coalgebra R C] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
    [Comodule R C M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [Comodule R C N]
    extends M →ₗ[R] N where

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.Simps.apply
docstring: See Note [custom simps projection].
code: def Simps.apply (f : Hom R C M N) : M → N :=

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.add_apply
docstring: Addition of comodule morphisms is pointwise addition.
code: theorem add_apply (f g : Hom R C M N) (m : M) : (f + g) m = f m + g m :=

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.add_comp
docstring: Composition of comodule morphisms is additive in the left argument.
code:
theorem add_comp (g h : Hom R C N P) (f : Hom R C M N) :
    comp (g + h) f = comp g f + comp h f := by

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.add_toLinearMap
docstring: Addition of comodule morphisms is addition of the underlying linear maps.
code:
theorem add_toLinearMap (f g : Hom R C M N) :
    (f + g).toLinearMap = f.toLinearMap + g.toLinearMap :=

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.coe_mk
code: theorem coe_mk {f : M →ₗ[R] N} (h) : ((⟨f, h⟩ : Hom R C M N) : M → N) = f :=

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.coe_toLinearMap
code: theorem coe_toLinearMap (f : Hom R C M N) : ⇑f.toLinearMap = f :=

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeEquiv
docstring: Comodule morphisms `P → M ⊗[R] C` into the cofree comodule on `M` are exactly `R`-linear maps `P → M`: this is the universal property of the cofree comodule (the cofree functor is right adjoint to the forgetful functor).
code:
noncomputable def cofreeEquiv [Comodule R C P] :
    Hom R C P (M ⊗[R] C) ≃ (P →ₗ[R] M) := by

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeEquiv_apply
docstring: The forward direction of the cofree adjunction sends a comodule morphism to the `R`-linear map obtained by applying the counit to the `C` factor.
code:
theorem cofreeEquiv_apply [Comodule R C P] :
    ∀ φ : Hom R C P (M ⊗[R] C),
      cofreeEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (P := P) φ
        = (TensorProduct.rid R M).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
            (Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := C)).lTensor M ∘ₗ φ.toLinearMap := by

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeEquiv_symm_apply
docstring: The inverse direction of the cofree adjunction is `cofreeLift`.
code:
theorem cofreeEquiv_symm_apply [Comodule R C P] (g : P →ₗ[R] M) :
    (cofreeEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (P := P)).symm g = cofreeLift (C := C) g :=

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeLift
docstring: The comodule morphism `P → M ⊗[R] C` lifting an `R`-linear map `g : P → M`, namely `(g ⊗ id) ∘ ρ_P`.
code:
noncomputable def cofreeLift [Comodule R C P] (g : P →ₗ[R] M) :
    Hom R C P (M ⊗[R] C) := by

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeLift_apply
docstring: `cofreeLift g` acts as `(g ⊗ id) ∘ ρ_P`.
code:
theorem cofreeLift_apply [Comodule R C P] (g : P →ₗ[R] M) (p : P) :
    cofreeLift (C := C) g p = g.rTensor C (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := P) p) :=

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeLift_toLinearMap
docstring: The underlying linear map of `cofreeLift g` is `(g ⊗ id) ∘ ρ_P`.
code:
theorem cofreeLift_toLinearMap [Comodule R C P] (g : P →ₗ[R] M) :
    (cofreeLift (C := C) g).toLinearMap = g.rTensor C ∘ₗ coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := P) :=

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeMap
docstring: Functoriality of the cofree comodule in the coefficient module: an `R`-linear map `f : M → N` induces the comodule morphism `f ⊗ id : M ⊗[R] C → N ⊗[R] C`.
code:
noncomputable def cofreeMap (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    Hom R C (M ⊗[R] C) (N ⊗[R] C) := by

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeMap_apply
docstring: `cofreeMap f` acts as `f ⊗ id`.
code:
theorem cofreeMap_apply (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (x : M ⊗[R] C) :
    cofreeMap (C := C) f x = f.rTensor C x :=

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeMap_comp
docstring: The cofree functor preserves composition.
code:
theorem cofreeMap_comp (g : N →ₗ[R] P) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    cofreeMap (C := C) (g.comp f) = comp (cofreeMap (C := C) g) (cofreeMap (C := C) f) := by

theorem cofreeMap_toLinearMap (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    (cofreeMap (C := C) f).toLinearMap = f.rTensor C :=

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeUnit

noncomputable def cofreeUnit [Comodule R C P] :

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeUnit_apply

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofree_retract
docstring: The cofree coaction is split by `(ε ∘ -) ∘ counit`: applying the counit to the right factor and then the right unitor retracts the cofree coaction. This is the right-counit law of `C` transported to `M ⊗[R] C`, and underlies the cofree adjunction.

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.comp

theorem comp_assoc (h : Hom R C P Q) (g : Hom R C N P) (f : Hom R C M N) :

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.comp_id

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.comp_neg

    comp g (-f) = -comp g f := by

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.comp_smul

theorem comp_smul (r : R) (g : Hom R C N P) (f : Hom R C M N) :

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.comp_sub
docstring: Composition of comodule morphisms is subtractive in the right argument.

docstring: Pushing the counit past `g ⊗ id`.

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.counit_rTensor_assoc_symm
docstring: Pushing the counit through the inverse associator, element form.
code:
private theorem counit_rTensor_assoc_symm (m : M) (y : C ⊗[R] C) :
    ((Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := C)).lTensor M).rTensor C
        ((TensorProduct.assoc R M C C).symm (m ⊗ₜ y))
      = (TensorProduct.assoc R M R C).symm
          (m ⊗ₜ (Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := C)).rTensor C y) := by

code: instance funLike : FunLike (Hom R C M N) M N where

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.groupLikeEquiv
docstring: Comodule morphisms between comodules attached to the same group-like element are exactly ordinary linear maps.
code:
def groupLikeEquiv (g : GroupLike R C) :
    letI : Comodule R C M := groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) g
    letI : Comodule R C N := groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) g
    Hom R C M N ≃ (M →ₗ[R] N) := by

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.groupLikeEquiv_apply
docstring: Applying `groupLikeEquiv` returns the underlying linear map.
code:
theorem groupLikeEquiv_apply (g : GroupLike R C) :
    letI : Comodule R C M := groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) g
    letI : Comodule R C N := groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) g
    ∀ f : Hom R C M N,
      groupLikeEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) g f = f.toLinearMap := by

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.groupLikeEquiv_symm_apply
docstring: The inverse of `groupLikeEquiv` sends a linear map to the corresponding morphism of group-like comodules.
code:
theorem groupLikeEquiv_symm_apply (g : GroupLike R C) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    letI : Comodule R C M := groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) g
    letI : Comodule R C N := groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) g
    (groupLikeEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) g).symm f =
      ofGroupLike (R := R) (C := C) g f :=

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.groupLikeEquiv_symm_apply_apply
docstring: Pointwise form of `groupLikeEquiv_symm_apply`.
code:
theorem groupLikeEquiv_symm_apply_apply (g : GroupLike R C) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (m : M) :
    letI : Comodule R C M := groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) g
    letI : Comodule R C N := groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) g
    (groupLikeEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) g).symm f m = f m :=

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.groupLikeToRegular
docstring: The canonical morphism from the group-like comodule on `R` attached to `g` into the regular comodule, sending `r` to `r • g`.

@[expose] def groupLikeToRegular (g : GroupLike R C) :

    Hom R C R C := by

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.groupLikeToRegular_apply
docstring: The morphism `groupLikeToRegular g` sends `r` to `r • g`.
code:
theorem groupLikeToRegular_apply (g : GroupLike R C) (r : R) :
    letI : Comodule R C R := groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := R) g
    groupLikeToRegular (R := R) (C := C) g r = r • (g : C) :=

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.groupLikeToRegular_toLinearMap
docstring: The underlying linear map of `groupLikeToRegular g` sends `r` to `r • g`.

theorem groupLikeToRegular_toLinearMap (g : GroupLike R C) :
    letI : Comodule R C R := groupLike (R := R) (C := C) (M := R) g
    (groupLikeToRegular (R := R) (C := C) g).toLinearMap =
      LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R C (g : C) :=

label: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.ker_finite
